file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.content: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Generated on: 2026-05-12 06:42:50 GMT+0000 SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration | LBN Public Original content: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_LBN_FC_OPTION/a9ef2c7d33814c29aa7bc869cc3aff0a?locale=en- US&state=PRODUCTION&version=LBN Warning This document has been generated from SAP Help Portal and is an incomplete version of the official SAP product documentation. The information included in custom documentation may not reflect the arrangement of topics in SAP Help Portal, and may be missing important aspects and/or correlations to other topics. For this reason, it is not for production use. For more information, please visit https://help.sap.com/docs/disclaimer. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 1 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- General Are you a carrier with a general question about using SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What happens with my data and who can see or access it? The only data seen by another business partner is the data you share with them during the subcontracting or tendering process. Note: SAP support will be able to see your data if a support-related task requires them to do so. Where is my data stored? SAP Business Network for Logistics runs on SAP Business Technology Platform, which uses either the Amazon Web Services infrastructure hosted in a data center in Frankfurt, Germany, or the Microsoft Azure infrastructure hosted in a data center in the state of Washington, US. You can check the data center locations of SAP Business Network for Logistics at SAP Trust Center . How can I as a carrier report an incident? To report an incident, do either of the following: Call Customer Interaction Center. When calling, please have your S-user ID ready. You are also recommended to have your installation number or system ID to hand. For more information about calling Customer Interaction Center, see https://support.sap.com/en/contact-us/phone.html . In the upper-right corner of the Fiori Launchpad window, click the  Raise Incident icon. Then click SAP One Support in the pop-up dialog box, and create an incident on the Contact SAP Support page. After reporting an incident, you can follow its progress using the SAP Support Portal service. See https://support.sap.com/en/index.html . Which languages are supported? Freight collaboration apps support the following languages: Arabic Bulgarian Chinese Simplified Chinese Traditional Croatian Czech Danish Dutch Finnish French German 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 2 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- Greek Hebrew Hungarian Italian Japanese Korean Malay Norwegian Polish Portuguese for Brazil Romanian Russian Serbo-Croatian Slovak Spanish Swedish Thai Turkish How do I change the app language? The app language is defined by the language setting in your Web browser. You can also change the language by clicking the user button in the upper-right corner of the Fiori launchpad window and choosing Settings. Then choose Language & Region and select the language that you want. How do I change the local time zone? The local time zone is defined by the location or time setting of your operating system. How can I contact a business partner? You can't chat directly to business partners, but you can both leave notes for each other. In addition, the contact details of your business partners are available in multiple apps. Where can I find a glossary for the terms used in the apps and user assistance? You can find term definitions in the SAP terminology database: 1. Go to http://sapterm.com and click Look up SAP terminology.  Note The times of departures and arrivals are displayed in the time zone of the location. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 3 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- 2. Enter the search criteria: a. Enter the term. b. Select the source and target language. c. Select the Advanced Search checkbox and choose the SBN-LBN-FC component. 3. Click Search. Manage Network Are you a carrier with a question about joining and setting up yourself on SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration? If so, take a look at these FAQs. I need a user. How do I create one? Your administrator needs to create the users (and assign roles to them) on behalf of their colleagues. The administrator (not the network) is responsible for creating and maintaining the users. Also, when someone leaves the company, the administrator is responsible for deleting the user. Define User Settings App Are you a carrier with a question about your Define User Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Which user settings can be personalized? You can set the distance unit of measure to either miles or kilometers. You can also subscribe to various notification services. What happens when I set the distance unit of measure? Once you set the distance unit of measure to miles or kilometers, the system applies this setting to all the business documents that you create subsequently. Note that the system does not apply this setting to the documents that you have already created. How can I get an email alert for a specific functionality? You can subscribe to notifications for a specific functionality in the Define User Settings app. The list of users subscribed to a notification will display in the Manage Notification Settings app. The list of options and their description is available at Manage Notification Settings (Carrier). What are the scenarios for which I can subscribe to a notification service? The available scenarios are listed under Scenarios. To subscribe, select the checkbox under Subscribed. The list of scenarios and their description is available at Manage Notification Settings (Carrier). What happens when I subscribe to a notification service? Once you subscribe to the notification service for a scenario, the system can send email notifications based on the settings you make in the Manage Notification Settings app. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 4 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- What do I need to do before I subscribe to a scenario? You must specify an email address. I have specified an email address but I do not want to subscribe to a scenario at present. Is that possible? Yes, you can maintain an email address without subscribing to a scenario. Do I need to maintain an email address even if I do not want to subscribe to a scenario? No, you do not need to maintain an e-mail address unless you want to subscribe to a scenario. How do I change the app language? The app language is defined by the language setting in your Web browser. You can also change the language by clicking the user button in the upper-right corner of the Fiori launchpad window and choosing Settings. Then choose Language & Region and select the language that you want. Related Information Define User Settings (Carrier) Manage Notification Settings App Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Notification Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What are the scenarios for which I can schedule alerts? The scenarios for which you can schedule alerts are listed in Scenarios pane on the left side. Select a scenario to set the schedule. How can I add a user/notification to the Manage Notification Settings app? This is done via the Define User Settings app. How can I get an email alert for a specific functionality? You can subscribe to notifications for a specific functionality via the Define User Settings app. The list of users subscribed to a notification will display in the Manage Notification Settings app. The list of options and their description is available at Manage Notification Settings (Carrier). Related Information Manage Notification Settings (Carrier) User Management App Are you a carrier administrator with a question about your User Management app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Is this app relevant for all carriers? Yes. This app is relevant for carriers that have purchased SAP Business Network Logistics Provider, basic membership. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 5 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- How can I see a given record in the display? Validate if you have any filters applied. There are also tabs that you could click into to reduce the searchable list down to a smaller set. How can I edit a given record? Tell your administrator to grant you the necessary access rights. You can find the list of the access rights inCreate a User and Assign User Groups . What happens after I create a user in this app? The new user is created in your company's tenant and added to the specified user groups. The system will send an activation email to the user so that he or she can set the password and access the relevant apps. Note that if the user already exists in SAP Business Network for Logistics, no activation email will be sent because the user was already activated for the network. What happens after I delete a user in this app? The user is deleted from your company's tenant and can no longer access the apps in the tenant. The app shows some existing user groups for assignment. Can I create or modify user groups? The user groups are predefined and cannot be created, modified, or deleted by users. Related Information User Management Manage Invitations App Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Invitations app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. I have received new invitations for connections. Is there a stipulated time frame within which I must respond to these invitations? No, there are no restrictions on the response time. I have rejected an invitation accidentally. Can I resend a response or must I contact the SAP Business Network for Logistics team and place a request for that specific invitation? Once you accept or reject an invitation, you cannot reverse it as the system updates the business partner instantaneously. Also, there is no option to submit a request to the SAP Business Network for Logistics team. Is it mandatory to provide a rejection reason when I reject an invitation? No, it is not mandatory. However, when you specify a rejection reason, it would help the inviter understand the issues. What happens once I accept an invitation? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 6 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- When you accept an invitation from the inviter, the system notifies the inviter that you have accepted it. You can connect with the inviter’s network to perform business transactions. What happens once I reject an invitation? When you reject an invitation, the system notifies the inviter that you have rejected it. You cannot connect with the inviter’s network to perform any business transactions. When I receive a new invitation, will I be notified? By default you will not receive any alert or notification when you receive a new invitation. All the new invitations will be displayed on the New tab until you send a response. However, you can enable email notifications on new invitations by subscribing the Invitations notification scenario in the Define User Settings app and configure the notification settings in the Manage Notification Settings app. Why can't I locate my invitation? You can try the following: Check if you have any filters or searches applied to the current page that could limit your list if you are searching for something specific that does not match the business partner you want to connect with. Click around to the tabs with other status tags. For example, click the Accepted or Rejected tab to search for your invitation. Can I restrict the number of invitations displayed? No, you cannot restrict the display of invitations. The invitations are grouped based on the response status and you can view them on the corresponding tabs. I need to verify the details of the inviter before responding to the invitation. Where can I find more information? The system does not currently enable you to access additional inviter details. Related Information Manage Invitations Freight Requests for Quotation App Are you a carrier with a question about your Freight Requests for Quotation app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight RFQ? On the app tile, the number of new freight RFQs is updated and, within the app, the new freight RFQ is displayed in the New worklist. Additionally, the ordering party may send you an email notification. Am I the only carrier who receives a freight RFQ or do other carriers receive it too?  Note "Freight request for quotation" is abbreviated to "freight RFQ". 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 7 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- Depending on the ordering party's strategy, they may send the freight RFQ to multiple carriers (and will award the job to whichever carrier can meet their criteria). In the worklists, what does the Remaining Time column indicate? It shows the time that you have to accept or reject the freight RFQ. When the remaining time is over (in which case no number is displayed), you can no longer accept, reject, or change your previous response. What does My Latest Response: Accepted Automatically mean? It indicates that the freight RFQ was accepted automatically when the remaining time ran out. In the worklists, what does the Accept Automatically column indicate? When the shipper sends you a freight RFQ, they decide whether or not you need to respond to accept the freight RFQ. Accept Automatically: Yes indicates that the shipper assumes you can complete the job, and therefore the freight RFQ will be automatically accepted when the remaining time runs out – unless you reject it. Accept Automatically: No indicates that the shipper doesn't make any assumptions, and therefore you need to accept the freight RFQ if you want to be considered for the job. What happens when I accept or reject a freight RFQ? A freight quotation is automatically created and is sent to the ordering party. You can view the created freight quotation in the Freight Quotations app. Why does the All worklist include more freight RFQs than the combined total of the New and Responded To worklists? The New and Responded To worklists only contain new freight RFQs up until the departure date of their corresponding freight orders, whereas the All worklist displays all freight RFQs. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight RFQ in the worklists? You can filter the worklists by various criteria. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. Related Information Freight Contracting Freight Requests for Quotation Freight Quotations Freight Quotations App Are you a carrier with a question about your Freight Quotations app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How will I know if a freight quotation is successful or rejected by the ordering party? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 8 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- The status of the freight quotation is updated in the app. Why does the All worklist include more freight quotations than the combined total of the Response Received and No Response Received worklists? The Response Received and No Response Received worklists only contain new freight quotations up until the departure date of their corresponding freight orders, whereas the All worklist displays all freight quotations. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight quotation in the worklists? You can filter the worklists by various criteria. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. Related Information Freight Contracting Freight Requests for Quotation Freight Quotations Freight Orders for Confirmation App Are you a carrier with a question about your Freight Orders for Confirmation app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight order? On the app tile, the number of new freight orders is updated and, within the app, the new freight order is displayed in the New worklist. In the worklists, what does the Remaining Time / Freight Quotations column indicate? For some freight orders, the ordering party may specify a time window in which they would preferably like to receive your response. As long as you don't reject the freight order, even after the remaining time is over (in which case, no time is displayed), you may still be able to respond up until the freight order's departure date. If a freight quotation is displayed in the column, it means the freight order is the end product of the tendering process that began in the Freight Requests for Quotations app. In this case, you are required to confirm or reject the freight order. What does My Latest Response: Confirmed Automatically mean? It indicates that the freight order was confirmed automatically when the remaining time was over. What does Confirm Automatically indicate? When the shipper sends you a freight order, they decide whether you need to respond to confirm the freight order. Confirm Automatically: Yes indicates that the shipper assumes you can complete the job, and therefore the freight order will be automatically confirmed when the remaining time runs out – unless you reject it. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 9 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- Confirm Automatically: No indicates that the shipper doesn't make any assumptions, and therefore you need to confirm the freight order if you want to do the job. Why does the All worklist include more freight orders than the combined total of the New and Responded To worklists? The New and Responded To worklists only contain new freight orders up until their departure date, whereas the All worklist displays all freight orders. Why was my note not saved and sent to the ordering party? Notes are only saved and sent to the ordering party when you confirm or reject the freight order. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight order in the worklists? You can filter the worklists by various criteria. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. Why are some of the fields missing in the SAP ECC shipment document? As of now, the system does not display all the information in a shipment document. You can only view the critical fields in the Freight Orders for Confirmation app. Why am I not able to confirm the shipment from SAP ECC? As of now, you can only view an SAP ECC shipment. Related Information Freight Orders for Confirmation Confirm Freight Bookings (Ocean) App Are you a carrier with a question about your Confirm Freight Bookings app for ocean freight? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight booking? On the app tile, the number of new freight bookings is updated and, within the app, the new freight bookings are displayed in the New worklist. Why was my note not saved and sent to the shipper? Notes are only saved and sent to the shipper when you confirm or reject the freight booking. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight booking in the worklists? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 10 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 10 of 10 --
