Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. In the Stages tab, I am unable to edit the UN/LOCODE field all the time. Why? Only when the ordering party has not specified the location details for any of the stages in the freight booking you can add a UN/LOCODE. Note that once the location details are available, you cannot edit this field. I am unable to edit the Vessel, Voyage, and IMO details in the Information tab. Why? You can only view all the details in the Information tab. You can edit these details for the main carriage stage in the Stages tab. Confirm Freight Bookings (Air) App Are you a carrier with a question about your Confirm Freight Bookings app for air freight? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight booking? On the app tile, the number of new freight bookings is updated and, within the app, the new freight bookings are displayed in the New worklist. Why was my note not saved and sent to the shipper? Notes are only saved and sent to the shipper when you confirm or reject the freight booking. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight booking in the worklists? You can filter the worklists by various criteria. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. In the Stages tab, I am unable to edit the IATA code field all the time. Why? Only when the ordering party has not specified the location details for any of the stages in the freight booking you can add a IATA. Note that once the location details are available, you cannot edit this field. I am unable to edit the Flight Code details in the Information tab. Why? You can only view all the details in the Information tab. You can edit this information for the main carriage stage in the Stages tab. Freight Orders for Reporting App Are you a carrier with a question about your Freight Orders for Reporting app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Note that this app has been deprecated and will be sunset shortly. This app has been replaced with the new app Manage Freight Execution. When is a freight order visible in Freight Orders for Reporting app? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 11 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- The freight order is visible in the app after the freight order has been confirmed in the Freight Orders for Confirmation app. Can I report events in any sequence? There is no strict sequence in which you must report the events. The app enables you to skip events in the Events to Report worklist and to report events from the Reporting section of a freight order in any sequence. When should I report a delay and when should I report the final time of an event? The decision on what to report and when to report it depends on your agreement with the ordering party. If you just want to inform the ordering party when events were completed, only report the final time for each event (i.e. when the event was completed). If you also want to inform the ordering party about delays as they occur, use the Report Delay dialog to send updates to the ordering party. Why are events sometimes highlighted red? When you report an event that is delayed, the event is highlighted red. Can I adjust the final time after reporting it? Yes, you can. If, for example, you make a mistake when reporting a final time, you can simply report the final time again. Can I enter a final time for an event that's marked as Unable to Report? Yes, you can. Why are all actions unavailable for a freight order with the status Reporting in Progress (freight order reconfirmation required)? The status indicates that the ordering party has updated the freight order. Therefore, before you can continue reporting the events, the freight order must be confirmed again in the Freight Orders for Confirmation app. What's the difference between skipping an event and marking an event as Unable to Report? If you don't have the information to report the event currently displayed in the Events to Report worklist, you can skip the event and report it later. If you realize that you'll never be able to report the skipped event, you can mark the event as Unable to Report. By doing so, the event is no longer considered as skipped and missing a final time. Related Information Freight Orders for Reporting Manage Freight Execution App (Carrier) Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Freight Execution app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. When is a freight document visible in Manage Freight Execution app? The freight order is visible in the app after the freight order has been confirmed in the Freight Orders for Confirmation app. When the freight document is set to Ready for Execution in the external system and the corresponding tracking initiation request is triggered, the freight document is visible in the app. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 12 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- Can I report events in any sequence? There is no sequence in which you must report the events. The app enables you to skip events and to report events for a freight document in any sequence. When should I report a delay and when should I report the final time of an event? The decision on what to report and when to report it depends on your agreement with the ordering party. If you just want to inform the ordering party when events were completed, only report the final time for each event, that is, when the event was completed. You can also inform the ordering party about delays as they occur by reporting the Delay as an unplanned event. Can I adjust the final time after reporting it? Yes, you can. If, for example, you make a mistake when reporting a final time, you can simply report the final time again. What's the difference between skipping an event and marking an event as Unable to Report? If you do not have the information to report the event, you can skip the event and report it later. If you realize that you'll never be able to report the skipped event, you can mark the event as Unable to Report. By doing so, the event is no longer considered as skipped and missing a final time. Can I enter a final time for an event that's marked as Unable to Report? Yes, you can. If an actual event is reported by the shipper, carrier and the visibility provider, where can I see all the events? If an actual event is reported by the shipper, carrier and the visibility provider, then you can view all these events in the Events History pane. You can view the details of which business partner reported the event in the Business Partner field. Can I update my freight document once the reporting has started? Yes, you can update the freight document once the reporting has started. However, you cannot modify the planned events which have already been reported. Note that the document has to be updated with the option of same or higher precedence. For more information, seeAdministration Guide for Shippers. In the guide, see Manage Freight Execution in the Configuring Additional Services section. Related Information Manage Freight Execution Invoice Freight Documents App Are you a carrier with a question about your Invoice Freight Documents app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight document? You can view the number of new freight documents on the Invoice Freight Documents app tile on the Fiori launchpad. You can also view all new freight documents in the To be Invoiced worklist in the app. In the Invoicing in Process and All worklists, what does the Invoices field indicate? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 13 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- For the freight documents for which invoices have already been created or submitted, this field lists the number of invoices that are already created or submitted. What happens when I select multiple freight documents and choose Create Invoice? The system creates individual invoices for each of the selected freight documents. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight document in the worklist? You can use the search options in the header area of the worklist page to find a freight document. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. Why am I still able to create an invoice for an document which is in the Invoicing in Process worklist? When you create an invoice, due to split and consolidation criteria, the system creates multiple invoices. When one of the invoices is deleted, the system allows you to create a new invoice for the charges included in the deleted invoice. Related Information Invoice Freight Documents Manage Invoices App Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Invoices app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find an invoice in the worklist? You can use the search option in the header area of the worklist page to find an invoice. Note that the search option is case-sensitive. You must use a wildcard character (*) if you do not enter the complete invoice ID. In the invoice detail view, in the items section, what do the freight documents indicate? The items table displays the included freight document items. If the invoice has been created with multiple freight documents, the system displays the freight order details in this section.  Note If the charging is based on stages or a tour, the individual lines in the item table indicate various stages of the freight order. If the charging is based on freight items, the individual lines in the item table indicate various items of the freight order. Alternatively, if the charging is for the entire document, there is one entry each for each freight order in the item table. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 14 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- Where do the charge details, rates, and amounts in the invoice come from? The freight order from the ordering party contains details of charges based on the agreement between you and the ordering party. During invoice creation, the system transfers these charges from the freight order to the invoice. Why do I see multiple invoices for a single freight order? If the freight order contains different payment terms or currencies for various stages or items, the system cannot combine them into a single invoice. This results in the invoice being split, and hence, the system creates multiple invoices. Why do I see multiple invoices when I create a collective invoice? The system creates multiple invoices for the following reasons: The ordering parties or invoicing parties are different in the selected freight orders. The document currencies are different in the selected freight orders. The freight orders are charged differently. For example, it is not possible to combine two freight orders if one is charged by items and the other is charged by stages. The payment terms are different in the selected freight orders. Why do I see logistical data and calculation rules in a dialog box for some of the rate amounts? If the rate amount is a flat rate for a charge line, you can directly edit the rate amount. If the rate amount is based on a rate table, the system displays the logistical data and any calculation rules in a dialog box. You can view and modify the logistical data based on which the rate amount is calculated in this dialog box. Why does the final amount not change when I change the rate amount? When you change the rate amount, the system does not recalculate the final amount. Hence, you must change the final amount accordingly. What is the difference between the exclude and delete options? You can exclude an existing charge from the charges table by choosing the exclude charge icon. You can also choose to include the charge again. You can only delete a new charge that you have added from the charges table. When should I use the download or upload invoice option? When you have multiple invoices to submit, you can use the invoice template option, which reduces manual effort. If you have invoices from your system as a PDF or Microsoft Excel file, you can download prefilled invoice templates from SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration in Microsoft Excel file in the xlsx format. You can use a custom program to automatically port the contents of your PDF or Microsoft Excel file into the downloaded invoice template. You can also manually enter the data into the downloaded invoice template. When you upload the Microsoft Excel file of xlsx format to the Manage Invoices app, the system updates the invoice with the values from the uploaded file. When I enter a new charge, I get an error message indicating that the charge is a duplicate. Why? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 15 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- This error message appears when you add a new charge and enter a charge type that exists already for the same logistical reference. The system does so because you can modify the rate amount and final amount of the existing charge line instead of adding a new charge. Related Information Manage Invoices Credit Memos App Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Invoices app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a credit memo in the worklist? You can use the search option in the header area of the worklist page to find a credit memo. Note that the search option is case-sensitive. You must use a wildcard character (*) if you do not enter the complete credit memo ID. I am unable to perform any actions on the credit memo. Why? As of now, you can only view credit memos that have been created when you cancel invoices with credit memo. You cannot modify a credit memo document. Review Freight Documents App Are you a carrier with a question about your Review Freight Documents app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I know when there is a new freight document? You can view all new freight documents on the All tab worklist in the app. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a freight document in the worklist? You can use the search options in the header area of the worklist page to find a freight document. Note: If you enter the filter criteria by typing them, the fields are case-sensitive and you must include an asterisk (*) at the start or end of any IDs or names not written in full. How is this app different from the Invoice Freight Documents app? With the Invoice Freight Documents app, you can see the freight documents from those customers who have registered you for the carrier invoicing process. You can submit invoices for those freight documents. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 16 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- With the Review Freight Documents app, you can see the freight documents from those customers who have registered you for the self-billing process. If you agree with the freight document charges, you do not need to perform any action. Related Information Review Freight Documents Manage Disputes App Are you a carrier with a question about your Manage Disputes app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a dispute in the worklist? You can use the search option in the header area of the worklist page to find a dispute. How can I include an unplanned charge that needs to be added to the list of charges? You can create a dispute from the Review Freight Documents app and choose the add charge line option. You can enter a charge type and the amounts for the unplanned charge in this charge line. How does the ordering party know when I add an unplanned charge? Before you submit the dispute document, you can add a note for the new charge line. You can also attach files in the Attachments section How do I include my disagreements on the line-haul rate amount and final amount specified by the ordering party? If you have already created a dispute for the freight document and have not submitted the dispute document, you can choose to modify the rate amount and final amount for the specific charge line. How do I know if the ordering party has responded to my dispute? You can view the disputes that you submitted to the ordering party on the Submitted tab. When the ordering party completes their review of the dispute, you can view the dispute on the To be Approved tab or on the Resolved tab. If the ordering party accepts all the disputes, you can view the dispute on the Resolved tab. If the ordering party rejects or submits a proposal to one of the disputed charge lines, you can view the dispute on the To be Approved tab. What happens when I accept all the proposals from the ordering party? The system sets the document to Resolved status, and the ordering party also sees the document as Resolved. Why am I unable see the changes in the freight document in my dispute document that I created earlier? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 17 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- When you create a dispute document, the system uses the data from the freight document that is available at the time of creation. If the freight document changes meanwhile, the system does not update the dispute document. If there are disputes on the changes, you must create another dispute on the freight document once the existing dispute has been resolved. Related Information Manage Disputes Self-Book Dock Appointments App Are you a carrier with a question about your Self-Book Dock Appointments app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Why can't I find a confirmed freight order in the Ready for Booking table? If the stop of your freight order does not match any active docking locations maintained in the Manage Entities app, your freight order will not be eligible for appointment booking. Why am I not notified when a shipper reschedules or cancels my dock appointment? To be notified about an appointment change, you must subscribe to the Reschedule Appointment or Cancel Appointment scenario in the Define User Settings app. Why do my dock appointments get canceled? Your dock appointments can get canceled manually by the shipper, and the shipper usually provides the cancellation reason. Your dock appointments can also get canceled automatically. This happens right after the corresponding order, for which the appointment was created, is canceled. Are dock appointments on the Booked Appointments page always editable? No, a dock appointment becomes read-only when the booking cut-off time is reached. Why is my freight order not displayed in the Self-Book Dock Appointments app? Depending on the settings that your shipper has taken, a freight order is displayed upon freight order creation or upon freight order confirmation. If a confirmation is required, you first need to confirm the freight order in the Freight Orders for Confirmation app before it is displayed on the Ready for Booking tab. In case of doubt, please ask your ordering party (shipper) if they have already sent the freight order from their transportation management (TM) system. Why is it not possible to add an attachment? If there are any attachments that you want to add to the appointment, choose the Add button under the Attachments section. You can only upload files that meet the following criteria: Files of the formats: jpg, gif, png, pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx Image files less than 6MB file size Document files less than 5MB file size File name less than 150 characters including file extension Why is it not possible to cancel an appointment? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 18 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- The system allows you to cancel only those appointments for which the associated gate logbooks are in status Ready for Check-In or Cancelled. Where can I find an already booked appointment? Appointments that have already been booked are displayed on the Booked Appointments tab. What should I do if I do not yet know the driver or license plate of the truck that will pick up the cargo items? The driver and license plate details are not required to book an appointment. The shipper or gate operator can enter them at check-in. What should I do if I want to book a slot at a given time but the calendar is blocked? Your shipper can block the calendar according to his needs. Please contact your shipper and ask him if he can release a time slot or book an appointment for you. How can I see the details of an appointment that was booked by my shipper on my behalf? To view the details of a booked appointment, go to the Booked Appointment tab and search for the freight order ID. Aditionally, if you want to receive email notifications, you can subscribe to the relevant dock appointment scheduling scenarios using the Manage Notification Settings (Carrier) app. How can I get to know if booking a dock appointment is a requirement? The standard processes in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration do not rely on the dock appointment scheduling features. Please contact your shipper or customer directly to determine if they would like you to book an appointment with them or not. Related Information Self-Book Dock Appointments System Connections App Are you a carrier with a question about your System Connections app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Where can I find information about APIs for SAP Business Network for Logistics? Go to SAP API Hub at https://api.sap.com/package/LbnFreightCollaborationTenderingSubcontracting?section=Overview Where can I find information about OAuth 2.0 authentication for inbound-to-network communication? For more information about OAuth 2.0 authentication, please report an incident under component SBN-LBN-INT. Can I add to the list of supported API operations? The list of operations is fixed and cannot be added to. Related Information System Connections (Carrier) 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 19 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- General Are you a shipper with a general question about using SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What happens with my data and who can see or access it? The only data seen by another business partner is the data you share with them during the subcontracting or tendering process. Note: SAP support will be able to see your data if a support-related task requires them to do so. Where is my data stored? SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration runs on SAP Business Technology Platform, which uses either the Amazon Web Services infrastructure hosted in a data center in Frankfurt, Germany, or the Microsoft Azure infrastructure hosted in a data center in the state of Washington, US. The data used in the solution is also stored in the data center. Which languages are supported? Freight collaboration apps support the following languages: Arabic Bulgarian Chinese Simplified Chinese Traditional Croatian Czech Danish Dutch Finnish French German Greek Hebrew Hungarian Italian Japanese Korean Malay Norwegian Polish Portuguese for Brazil 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 20 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 10 of 10 --

file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)_Part3
file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.content: Romanian Russian Serbo-Croatian Slovak Spanish Swedish Thai Turkish How do I change the app language? The app language is defined by the language setting in your Web browser. You can also change the language by clicking the user button in the upper-right corner of the Fiori launchpad window and choosing Settings. Then choose Language & Region and select the language that you want. How can I contact a business partner? You can't chat directly to business partners, but you can send and receive notes regarding tendering and freight orders if your system that is connected to the network supports the process. In addition, the contact details of your business partners are available in the Manage Carriers app. How can I as a shipper report an incident? To report an incident, click the Raise Incident icon in the upper-right corner of the Fiori Launchpad window. Then click SAP One Support in the pop-up dialog box, and create an incident on the Contact SAP Support page. For more information about reporting an incident, see https://support.sap.com/en/index.html . Where can I find a glossary for the terms used in the apps and user assistance? You can find term definitions in the SAP terminology database: 1. Go to http://sapterm.com and click Look up SAP terminology. 2. Enter the search criteria: a. Enter the term. b. Select the source and target language. c. Select the Advanced Search checkbox and choose the SBN-LBN-FC component. 3. Click Search. Define User Settings App Are you a shipper with a question about your Define User Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Which user settings can be personalized? You can subscribe to various notification services. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 21 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- How can I get an email alert for a specific functionality? You can subscribe to notifications for a specific functionality in the Define User Settings app. The list of users subscribed to a notification will display in the Manage Notification Settings app. The list of options and their description is available at Manage Notification Settings (Shipper). What are the scenarios for which I can subscribe to a notification service? The scenarios for which you can subscribe to a notification service are listed under Scenarios. To subscribe, select the checkbox under Subscribed. What happens when I subscribe to a notification service? Once you subscribe to the notification service for a scenario, the system can send email notifications based on the settings you make in the Manage Notification Settings app. What do I need to do before I subscribe to a scenario? You must specify an email address. I have specified an email address but I do not want to subscribe to a scenario at present. Is that possible? Yes, you can maintain an email address without subscribing to a scenario. Do I need to maintain an email address even if I do not want to subscribe to a scenario? No, you do not need to maintain an email address unless you want to subscribe to a scenario. How do I change the app language? The app language is defined by the language setting in your Web browser. You can also change the language by clicking the user button in the upper-right corner of the Fiori launchpad window and choosing Settings. Then choose Language & Region and select the language that you want. Related Information Define User Settings (Shipper) Configure Survey Delivery Settings App Are you a shipper with a question about your Configure Survey Delivery Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I set up a connection with Qualtrics system? To set up the connection from your SAP Business Network for Logistics system to the Qualtrics system, you must maintain the appropriate settings in the System Connections app. For more information, see Maintaining Qualtrics Connection. Can I create surveys in this app? No, you cannot create any surveys in this app. You can only configure the survey delivery settings. You must create surveys in the Qualtrics system. For more information on creating surveys in Qualtrics system, see Customer Delivery Experience Management with Qualtrics . 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 22 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- I can only view one scenario from the drop-down menu. Why? As of now, Customer Delivery is the only scenario available. What is a trigger condition? The trigger condition specifies on what event the system must trigger the survey email delivery. You can select one or more events from the drop-down menu that contains the pre-defined events. Can I customize the surveys? Yes, you can customize your surveys in the Qualtrics system based on the templates provided by SAP Business Network for Logistics. You can also create your own surveys if required. For more information on creating surveys in Qualtrics system, see Customer Delivery Experience Management with Qualtrics . Related Information Configure Survey Delivery Settings Manage Notification Settings App Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Notification Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What are the scenarios for which I can schedule alerts? The scenarios for which you can schedule alerts are listed in Scenarios pane on the left side. Select a scenario to set the schedule. How can I add a user/notification to the Manage Notification Settings app? This is done via the Define User Settings app. How can I get an email alert for a specific functionality? You can subscribe to notifications for a specific functionality via the Define User Settings app. The list of users subscribed to a notification will display in the Manage Notification Settings app. The list of options and their description is available at Manage Notification Settings (Shipper). Related Information Manage Notification Settings (Shipper) System Connections App Are you a shipper with a question about your System Connections app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Why should I maintain a system connection? You must maintain a system connection to exchange messages between your system and your network tenant. How do I get informed when a certificate is about to expire? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 23 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- To receive a notification about an expiring certificate, you need to register with the Cloud System Notification Subscriptions application. For more information, go to https://support.sap.com/en/my-support/systems-installations/cac.html . How can I renew a certificate when it expires? To renew a certificate, you must delete the old certificate once the validity expires and add a new certificate. Is it mandatory to have a certificate in my system that must be signed by one of the certificate authorities (CAs) available in the load balancer? Yes, it is mandatory to have a certificate signed by one of the CAs available in the load balancer. If you have a certificate that is signed by a different CA, you must create a ticket. The backend team of SAP Business Network for Logistics will upload your certificate to the network. Can I provide multiple certificates for a connection? Yes, you can provide multiple certificates for a connection. Can I have multiple connections for a system? Yes, you can have multiple connections for a system. Can I provide a message type of my own? No, you cannot provide a message type of your own. Can I maintain multiple system connections with the same combination of system ID and connection ID? The system uses the combination of a system ID and connection ID as a unique identifier for a connection. Hence you cannot use the same combination of IDs more than once. Can I edit a system connection once it is created? Yes. Only connection ID and system ID cannot be changed once created. Is it mandatory to maintain a destination in the Outbound from Network section? No, you do not need to maintain a destination for connection unless you need to send a document or a message from your network tenant to your system. Will the connection status automatically be updated if the status of the external system undergoes a change? That is, if the external system is removed from the landscape? No, there will not be any automatic updates in this scenario. The backend team of SAP Business Network for Logistics must manually change the connection status. With which types of external systems can I set up a connection? You can choose between the following connection types: SAP TM – SAP S/4HANA Qualtrics 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 24 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- Related Information System Connections (Shipper) Assign Codes App Are you a shipper with a question about your Assign Codes app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Can I upload my code lists from another external system than TM? You can upload you code lists from whatever source as long as you comply with the standard columns in the spreadsheet template provided for download by SAP Business Network for Logistics. Where can the carrier view the code list values that I maintain in the Assign Codes app? The carrier can view the values that you assign to a specific code list on the UI of the app where the codes are displayed. Would the existing documents become inconsistent if the mapping is modified? The mapping defines the values of code lists. Hence, a change in the mapping also signifies a change in the values. However, for existing documents, the mapping that the system applies during the document creation applies throughout the life cycle of the document. Is it mandatory to maintain code list mapping? No, it is not mandatory to maintain code list mapping. If no code list mapping is defined, LBN will use the values as defined in TM without any conversion. Related Information Assign Codes Configure Partner Connections App Are you a shipper with a question about your Configure Partner Connections app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What are the prerequisites for configuring this app? Before you can configure the partner connections, you must invite the business partner to SAP Business Network for Logistics, and you must agree with them if you want to establish a direct B2B connection or if you’ll connect via a network partner. How to do I get the credential information for a connection? You have to request the credentials from your business partner or network partner. Will all the services as defined in SAP Business Network for Logistics be supported by the business partner or network partner?  Note The term business partner refers to a carrier in your case. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 25 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- No. A business partner or network partner may support only a subset of services. Before you establish the connection, you must agree with the business partner or network partner which services they support. What is a network partner? A network partner can consist of a network of carriers that provides services like tracking, freight tendering, and subcontracting. SAP Business Network for Logistics offers out-of-the box integration to network partners depending on the supported services. Related Information Configure Partner Connections Invite Business Partners App Are you a shipper with a question about your Invite Business Partners app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. I want to upload a business partner Excel file. What is the size restriction for the file? The size of each business partner Excel file cannot be larger than 2 MB, and the maximum number of rows in it is 5,000. If I have, for instance, five business partners in a business partner Excel file, can I upload only three of them? No, you cannot select multiple business partners from a business partner Excel file and upload them. There is missing data in the business partner Excel file. However, the system still uploads the data. Why? The system uploads the Excel data because there is no Excel validation. However, when you save the uploaded data in your app, this may result in an error. How can I edit the business partner details? When you upload a business partner, you can edit the business partner details before saving using the in-line editing capability. You can also edit the business partner details later by selecting the business partner and choosing Edit. How do I enter missing business partner data before saving it in my network tenant? You can use one of the following ways to provide missing business partner data before saving: Maintain the missing data in the source system (for example, your SAP Transportation Management system) and re-export the business partner data to Excel. Manually enter the missing business partner data in the business partner Excel file before uploading the file to your network tenant. Manually enter the missing business partner data using the in-line edit functionality in your network tenant before saving the data. Why do I get an error message when I save business partner data? The error message appears for one of the following reasons: You have not entered the business partner details completely. For example, you may not have entered any data in the Business Partner ID field, which is mandatory. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 26 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- You have already uploaded this business partner in your app and chosen to submit the business partner to the backend team of SAP Business Network for Logistics to manage the connection request. If I accidentally delete a business partner, will I be able to re-upload the business partner? Yes, you can re-upload a business partner if you have not previously chosen Submit for the business partner. When you select a business partner and choose Submit, the system instantaneously sends a request to the backend team of SAP Business Network for Logistics to manage the connection request. Hence, you are not able to re-upload such business partners. What happens if I re-upload an existing business partner? When you re-upload an existing business partner, the system overwrites the existing business partner details with the new details. Can I create multiple business partners with the same system ID and business partner ID? No, you cannot create multiple business partners with the same IDs. The system uses the combination of the system ID and business partner ID as the unique identifier of a business partner. Why am I not able to edit business partner data once I submit the business partner? Once you submit the business partner data, the system instantaneously sends a request to the backend team of SAP Business Network for Logistics to manage the connection request. After this process, you cannot make any changes as these changes will not be updated in the administrator app. Can I re-submit business partner data? No, you cannot re-submit business partner data. What happens when a business partner accepts my invitation? When a business partner accepts your invitation to connect with you, the system updates the Accepted tab with the details of this business partner. You are now connected with this business partner and you can participate in business transactions with the business partner. What happens when a business partner rejects my invitation? When a business partner rejects your invitation to connect with you, the system updates the Rejected tab with the details of this business partner. You are not connected with this business partner and you cannot participate in business transactions with the business partner. A business partner has rejected my invitation. Can I contact this business partner through my network tenant? No, you cannot contact a business partner directly through your network tenant. Why is the Download Business Partners button available only on the Accepted tab? You use the Download Business Partners button to download the list of business partners with their network IDs that the system updates after they accept the connection invitation. You use this list to update the network IDs in your SAP Transportation Management (SAP TM) system. Can I partially download some of the business partners from the Accepted tab? Yes, you can select one or more business partners on the Accepted tab and download them in Microsoft Excel format. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 27 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- Related Information Invite Business Partners Assign Charge Codes App Are you a shipper with a question about your Assign Charge Codes app? If so, take a look at these FAQs Is it mandatory to assign a charge code to a charge type and condition type mapping? Yes, you must assign the charge types and condition types to the charge codes in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration. The users can view the charges present in the orders and the invoice documents via unified business network charge codes. This provides a standardized and consistent way of representing charge codes across users. How can I view or assign a carrier condition type to charge type mapping in my Transportation Management (TM) on SAP S/4 HANA 1809 system? You can view or assign condition types to charge types in Customizing for Transportation Management under Integration Enterprise Services Carrier Invoice Integration Assign Carrier Condition Types to SAP TM Charge Types . Where can the carrier view the charge codes of SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration that I maintain in the Assign Charge Codes app? The carrier can view the charge codes that you assign for a charge type and condition type in the Charge Code field on the Charges tab in the freight orders for settlement and invoice documents. When a carrier submits and sends the invoice to my transportation system, what happens to the charge codes of SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration? When a carrier submits and sends the invoice to your transportation system, the system performs a read operation in this configuration and replaces the business network charge codes with the corresponding condition types specific to your transportation system. Would the existing documents become inconsistent if the mapping is modified? The mapping defines the attributes of charge types. Hence, a change in the mapping also signifies a change in the attributes. However, for existing documents, the mapping that the system applies during the document creation applies throughout the life cycle of the document. Related Information Assign Charge Codes Manage Disputes App Are you a shipper with a question about your Disputes app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How often are the worklists updated? The worklists are updated when you open the app, filter the worklists, or use the manual refresh function. How can I find a dispute in the worklist? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 28 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- You can use the search option in the header area of the worklist page to find a dispute. How do I know when a carrier has submitted a dispute? You can view the disputes from carriers that need your action in the For Review worklist. The system displays the disputes from carriers that are reviewed and submitted by you in the Reviewed worklist. The system displays disputes that have been resolved in the Resolved worklist. What happens when the carrier accepts all my proposals? The system sets the document to Resolved status and the carrier also sees the document as Resolved. Related Information Manage Disputes General Settings App Are you a shipper with a question about your General Settings app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I create a new tolerance definition? On the Define Tolerance Range tab, click Edit to display the list of existing tolerance definitions. Then click Add to add a new line to the list, which you can then configure to your requirements, and click Save to save your settings. How do I edit a tolerance definition? On the Define Tolerance Range tab, click Edit to display the list of existing tolerance definitions, change the configurations as required, and click Save to save your settings. How do I edit a tolerance group? On the Define Tolerance Groups tab, click the tolerance group you want to edit. In the window that then appears, click Edit to display dropdown menus where you can change the configurations as required. Finally, click Save to save your settings. How do I assign a new tolerance group? On the Assign Tolerance Groups tab, click Edit to display the list of existing tolerance groups assignments. Then click Add to add a new line to the list, which you can then configure to your requirements, and click Save to save your settings. How do I edit a tolerance group assignment? On the Assign Tolerance Groups tab, click Edit to display the list of existing tolerance groups assignments. You can then use the dropdown menus to change the configurations as required. Finally, click Save to save your settings. Related Information General Settings Manage Entities App 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 29 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Entities app? If so, take a look at these FAQs I am unable to change the address of a docking location in the Manage Entities app. Why? You cannot change the address of a docking location as you have maintained the address information in the Manage Locations app. If you have the LocationProcessTemplate role template assigned, you can update the address of the location associated with the docking location in the Manage Locations app. What is Share Entity? What does the Permissions field in this section indicate? You can share the loading point, docking location, gate, and yard details with your business partner. Based on the settings you provide in the Permissions field, the business partner can either view or view and edit the entity details. Can I share a loading point with multiple docking locations? Yes, you can use the Enable Sharing with Docking Locations indicator to enable this feature. When you enable, the system displays the Shared Docking Locations field. You can choose the docking locations in the same time zone with which you want to share this loading point. Note that the system shares the same loading point capacity across all the shared docking locations. Can I share a gate with multiple yards? Yes, you can use the Enable Sharing with Yards indicator to enable this feature. When you enable, the system displays the Shared Yards field. You can choose the yards in the same time zone with which you want to share this gate. Location ID not mandatory when I create a new loading point. Why? As a loading point will be associated with a docking location, Location ID is not mandatory. What is a Block Time in a loading point in the Manage Entities app and what is a block time in the Manage Dock Appointments app? When you create a time block, the system blocks this time and you cannot create appointments during this time. You can also choose to create a time block only for carriers where only carriers cannot create appointments during this time. For planned time blocks, we recommend you to use the loading point level settings in the Manage Entities app. For any unplanned time blocks, we recommend you to use the block time settings in the Manage Dock Appointments app. I am unable to add a time block in a loading point. Why? If you have shared a loading point with multiple docking locations, you cannot add a time block for this loading point. You can disable the Enable Sharing with Docking Locations setting and then create a time block. I am unable to enable the Enable Sharing with Docking Locations setting for a loading point. Why? If you have blocked time for a loading point, the system does not allow you to enable the Enable Sharing with Docking Locations setting. You can delete the time block and then enable this setting. When should a driver arrive at the gate? The driver must arrive latest by the Arrival Lead Time that you specify in the Gate settings. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 30 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 10 of 10 --

file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)_Part4
file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.content: Related Information Manage Entities Manage Dock Appointments App Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Dock Appointments app? If so, take a look at these FAQs What are the constraints when I reschedule an appointment? You cannot change the activity or duration of an appointment. Also, you cannot reschedule an appointment to any non-business hours. Why can't I find a docking location on the Docking Locations table? To make a docking location visible on the table, you must first define the settings for the docking location and then activate the settings in the Docking Location Settings app. Related Information Manage Dock Appointments Manage Gate Operations App Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Gate Operations app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What can I do with the Manage Gate Operations app? As a gate operations manager, you can use this app to view the details of the vehicles that are ready to check-in and checkout of the yard. You can also perform the check-in and checkout process using this app. Who can use this app? Though this app is available for all shipper roles, those shippers who perform the role of gate operations manager can use this app to manage the gate operations. How is the planned check-in date and time calculated? The system calculates the planned check-in date and time based on the appointment details and the Arrival Lead Time that you specify in the gate settings in the Manage Entities app. What is actual check-in date and time? When you start the check-in process for a vehicle, the system updates the actual check-in date and time. What is actual checkout date and time? When you start the checkout process for a vehicle, the system updates the actual checkout date and time. Manage Locations App 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 31 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 1 of 10 -- Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Locations app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Can I create a docking location in the Manage Locations app? No, settings for docking locations are defined in the Docking Location Settings app. Can I have two location master data records with the same Location ID and different object types? No, the Location ID field must be unique. How do I set Source System ID/External ID if I am creating a location that is not copied from any external system? If you are creating a location from scratch, set Source System to LBN, and set External ID to the value of Location ID. Related Information Manage Locations Track Freight Movement App Are you a shipper with a question about your Track Freight Movement app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Note that this app has been deprecated and will be sunset shortly. This app has been replaced with the new app Manage Freight Execution. What prerequisite settings are required for using the Track Freight Movement app? The required prerequisite settings are described in the Administration Guide for Shippers. In the guide, see Freight Orders for Tracking in the Configuring Additional Services section. What data can be tracked by the Track Freight Movement app? The Track Freight Movement app tracks and displays the following data for you: The data manually reported by your carrier in the Freight Orders for Reporting app. The manually reported data includes actual events (departure, arrival, proof of pick-up, proof of delivery, and delay) and the attached documents (if any) in actual events. The manually reported data tracked by the app is also synchronized to your SAP TM or TM on S/4HANA system. Automated visibility data from a supported visibility provider, if your carrier provides it. The visibility data includes geographic location data and actual events (departure, arrival, delay, and delay dismissed). In the current delivery, the app only tracks visibility data for events with the DEPARTURE, ARRIV_DEST, POPU, POD, and DELAYED event codes. Only the tracking related data of a freight order is passed into the app, for example, freight order ID, stop locations, and events. The visibility data tracked by the app is also synchronized to your SAP TM or S/4HANA system, and the Freight Orders for Reporting app. In your SAP TM or SAP S/4HANA system, you can view both of the above data, but the geographic location data is only displayed in the Track Freight Movement app. What is the expected business or technical time window for a planned event? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 32 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 2 of 10 -- It is a time period between the earliest and latest expected business or technical date and time. By default, the earliest time is 10 minutes before the planned event time and the latest is 10 minutes after the planned event time. If you want to change the default, contact your system administrator to maintain SAP BAdI /SCMTMS/TOR_SE_TRCKPR_OUT. Why can't I see the planned shipping route on the map? The possible causes are: There are no events planned or reported at some stops. The location information for some stops is not specified in the location master data. The freight order was not executed as planned. When we say a freight document was not executed as planned, what does it mean? It means the latest actual event time reported at a stop is later than the earliest actual event time reported at its succeeding stop. What is the impact when a freight document was not executed as planned? The execution flow graphic only shows the events happened or planned at the stops, but there's no lines to connect the stops. All other events are listed in a table beneath the graphic. The map view only shows the actual shipping route, as well as all the events happened or planned in the entire process. I can't track a freight document that I have tracked before. Why? There are two possibilities, as shown below: The freight document was deleted because it reached its retention period. Based on data protection and privacy regulations, there is a retention period for the tracked process of a freight document. You can configure the retention period in the Blocking Store app. The freight document was canceled in your TM system. A cancellation request is sent from the TM system if any of the following conditions is met for a freight document: The value of TOR Lifecycle Status is not In Process or Completed. The value of TOR Execution Status is not Ready for Transportation Execution, In Execution, or Executed. The previously maintained carrier information has been removed. Why can't I find delay dismissed events in the Freight Orders for Reporting app, SAP TM, or SAP S/4HANA system? This is not supported in the current delivery. If an actual event is reported by both the Freight Orders for Reporting app and the visibility provider, which one takes precedence? Currently there is a software limitation on this: In the Track Freight Movement app, the reporting with the latest event time takes precedence. In the Freight Orders for Reporting app, the manually reported data takes precedence over the visibility data synced from the Track Freight Movement app. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 33 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 3 of 10 -- In the SAP TM or SAP S/4HANA system, the latest arrived data takes precedence. Thus, in some cases, the data displayed in the Track Freight Movement app may be inconsistent with the data shown in the Freight Orders for Reporting app, SAP TM or SAP S/4HANA system. Related Information Track Freight Movement Manage Freight Execution App (Shipper) Are you a shipper with a question about your Manage Freight Execution app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What prerequisite settings are required for using the Manage Freight Execution app? The required prerequisite settings are described in the Administration Guide for Shippers. In the guide, see Manage Freight Execution in the Configuring Additional Services section. What data can be tracked by the Manage Freight Execution app? The Manage Freight Execution app tracks and displays the following data for you: The data manually reported by your carrier in the Manage Freight Execution app. The manually reported data tracked by the app is also synchronized to your SAP TM or TM on S/4HANA system. The data reported by your B2B (business to business) carrier using the Provider API for Order Events (FC). The data reported by your visibility provider using the Provider API for Order Events (FC). Note that this option is only for the shippers who are using the SAP Business Network Global Track and Trace option. The data manually reported by the shipper in the Manage Freight Execution app. The reported data includes actual planned and unplanned events. For more information on the event types, see Code Lists. You can also view the attached documents (if any) in actual events. You can also see the details of the business partner who reported the event in the Reported By field. What is the expected business or technical time window for a planned event? It is a time period between the earliest and latest expected business or technical date and time. By default, the earliest time is 10 minutes before the planned event time and the latest is 10 minutes after the planned event time. If you want to change the default, contact your system administrator to maintain SAP BAdI /SCMTMS/TOR_SE_TRCKPR_OUT. I can't track a freight document that I have tracked before. Why? There are two possibilities, as shown below: The freight document was deleted because it reached its retention period. Based on data protection and privacy regulations, there is a retention period for the tracked process of a freight document. You can configure the retention period in the Blocking Store app. The freight document was canceled in your TM system. A cancellation request is sent from the TM system if any of the following conditions is met for a freight document: 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 34 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 4 of 10 -- The value of TOR Lifecycle Status is not In Process or Completed. The value of TOR Execution Status is not Ready for Transportation Execution, In Execution, or Executed. The previously maintained carrier information has been removed. If an actual event is reported by the shipper, carrier and the visibility provider, where can I see all the events? If an actual event is reported by the shipper, carrier and the visibility provider, then you can view all these events in the Events History pane. You can view the details of which business partner reported the event in the Business Partner field. Can I update my freight document once the reporting has started? Yes, you can update the freight document once the reporting has started. However, you cannot modify the planned events which have already been reported. Note that the document has to be updated with the option of same or higher precedence. For more information, seeAdministration Guide for Shippers. In the guide, see Manage Freight Execution in the Configuring Additional Services section. Related Information Manage Freight Execution Discover Business Partners App Do you have questions about your Discover Business Partners app? If so, take a look at these FAQs Why companies that match my search conditions are not returned in the Matched Results table? To find out the reason, check the following: Find out which type of SAP Business Network for Logistics tenant you are currently in. Business partners in SAP Business Network for Logistics are categorized in three types: Productive type: tenants created for productive use to conduct real business collaboration Test type: tenants created for test purpose System Integration (SI) type: tenants created by SAP system integration partners To find out which type of business partner tenant you are currently in, open the Manage Business Profile app and take a look at the ID on your company profile page. ID Tenant Type Starting with the prefix 'BNO'. No suffixes. Example: BNO-100000000001111 Productive Starting with the prefix 'BNO'. Ending with the suffix 'T'. Example: BNO-100000000001111-T Test 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 35 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 5 of 10 -- ID Tenant Type Starting with the prefix 'BNO'. Ending with the suffix 'D'. Example: BNO-100000000001111-D System Integration (SI) Make sure the potential business partners that you want to discover and connect already joined SAP Business Network for Logistics, and these companies must set the Make my business profile visible to potential business partners field to Yes in their Manage Invitations app. With the above conditions being met, the Discover Business Partners app restricts the scope of the business partners that you can find based on your own business partner type, as shown below: Your own business partner type Potential business partner type you can discover Productive Test System Integration Productive Yes No No Test No Yes Yes System Integration No Yes Yes Related Information Discover Business Partners Data Protection and Privacy Are you a shipper or a carrier with a question about data protection and privacy in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration? If so, take a look at these FAQs. Why is data protection and privacy important? Data protection and privacy of individual user data is a legal requirement, and every application that collects and distributes user data must be in accordance with statutory data protection laws. How does SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration ensure compliance with the data protection and privacy policies? The solution does the following to ensure compliance with the data protection and privacy policies: Deletes the user data from a business document on the expiry of the applicable retention periods Provides a retrieval function that enables users (data subjects) to find out what personal data is stored about them Logs changes to personal data and provides read access to sensitive personal data Who can retrieve personal data of a user and how? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 36 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 6 of 10 -- The data privacy officer can find the transactions that hold the personal information of the user using the Personal Data Management application. Related Information Data Protection and Privacy Retention Management App Are you a shipper or a carrier with a question about your Retention Management app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. What is the residence period and when does it start? It is the period between the end of business and the end of purpose for a data set. During the residence period, data remains in the database and can be used in case of subsequent processes related to the original purpose. At the end of the residence period, the data is blocked. Once the business document reaches the end of business, it enters the residence period. What is the blocking period and when does it start? The blocking period is the period between the end of the residence period and the deletion of the data. In the blocking period, only users with special privileges, such as a data protection officer, can access the data. At the end of the blocking period, the data is deleted. What is the retention period? The retention period is a combination of the residence period and the blocking period. It is the period between the end of the last business activity involving a specific object and the deletion of the corresponding data, subject to applicable laws. What is the end of purpose? The end of purpose for a business document is the point in time at which the primary processing purpose ends, such as a contract being fulfilled. For example, in the Freight Requests for Quotation app, a business partner is an item of master data. The end of purpose of this master data is the point in time at which the data is no longer relevant for business activities. How do I maintain the residence and blocking periods? And can I maintain different residence and blocking periods for each application? You can maintain the residence and blocking periods using the Retention Management app. You can specify the residence and blocking periods in months for an application type. If you do not specify a residence or a blocking period, the system sets it to 12 months by default. Yes, you can maintain different residence and blocking periods for each application. Related Information Retention Management 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 37 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 7 of 10 -- Blocking Store App Are you a shipper or a carrier with a question about your Blocking Store app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How can I view the personal data during the blocking period? You can use the Blocking Store app to view the personal data during the blocking period. Note that you can access the Blocking Store app only if you have the required authorization. What happens to the document once it reaches the end of the blocking period? Once the blocking period is over, all the personal data of the document is deleted permanently. Related Information Blocking Store Manage Business Profile App Are you a shipper or carrier with a question about your Manage Business Profile app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How do I edit or update the company profile? When you choose the Manage Business Profile tile on SAP Fiori Launchpad, the system opens the company profile page. You can edit or update the profile information by choosing the Edit icon in each section. How do I add multiple company addresses? Follow the instructions on Creating Additional Addresses. Why is it mandatory to maintain a default address? The default address is the address that will be displayed to other business partners in SAP Business Network Freight Collaboration. The default address is also the address that will be displayed when you launch the Manage Business Profile app. In general, the corporate address is chosen as the default address. My corporate address has changed. What should I do? After you launch the Manage Business Profile app, choose the Edit icon in the first section on your company profile and then enter your new address on the Address tab. Can I add a contact person for each of my addresses? No, you cannot add a contact person for each address. Is it mandatory to maintain sensitive data such as gross revenue in the profile? No, most information that you specify on the company profile page is optional. However, if you specify your business details, the business partner can use this information to analyze your business prospects before connecting with you. What are alternate identifiers and why should I specify them? 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 38 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 8 of 10 -- Alternate identifiers are standard industry codes or compliance details, for example the DUNS Number. If you maintain this information, the business partner can verify your credibility and eligibility before connecting with you. Related Information Manage Business Profile Manage Integration Logs App Are you a shipper or a carrier with a question about your Manage Integration Logs app? If so, take a look at these FAQs. One of the messages had a Failed status. Can I reprocess this message? Yes, after you solve the configuration or syntax issues pertaining to that business document, you can choose to reprocess this message. Only messages where the value in the Reprocessable column is set to Yes can be reprocessed. After I reprocessed a message, I am not able to view the log. Why? When you reprocess a message with the status Failed or Escalated, the system updates the status to Reprocessing. After the reprocessing has run, this message is updated to a final status of Failed, Escalated, or Completed. Where can I find the Manage Integration Logs - Integration Message Flow View version 1.0 app? The Manage Integration Logs - Integration Message Flow View (version 1.0) app has been sunset. You must switch to the new Manage Integration Logs (version 2.0) app. To start using the new app (as a shipper, solution owner or network owner), ask your system administrator to add the ManageIntegrationLogsDisplayTemplate and ManageIntegrationLogsTemplate roles to your role collection. If you are a carrier, data contributor or network participant, your role settings are managed by SAP Business Network for Logistics. The app shall be visible in your SAP Fiori launchpad. For any queries or concerns, please report an incident in SAP for Me categorized by component SBN-LBN-INT. Can I reprocess my logs after 30 days? No. The reprocessing of a message is limited to 29 days. After 30 days, you won’t be able to reprocess the message or download the payload. In the app, these messages are highlighted in grey. What is the difference between status and overall status? In the Documents tab, integration logs are aggregated based on the LBN IDs of the parties involved, the document ID, and the scenario. The overall status of an entry in the Documents tab is derived from the latest status of an individual log that's part of the aggregation. The Documents tab is only displayed for shippers, solution owners, and network owners. How can I configure email notifications for failed or escalated messages? You must schedule email notifications for the Integration Error V2 scenario as outlined in Manage Notification Settings (Shipper) and Manage Notification Settings (Carrier). Related Information Manage Integration Logs 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 39 This is custom documentation. For more information, please visit SAP Help Portal. -- 9 of 10 -- FAQs on Security Are you a shipper or a carrier with a question on security? If so, take a look at these FAQs. How can I monitor the messages that are coming into my system? Shippers and carriers can monitor all incoming and outgoing messages in their SAP Business Network for Logistics tenant using the Manage Integration Logs app. They can also subscribe to notifications to receive alerts in case of message failures. How frequently are the accounts monitored in real-time? Are there any periodic checks? Real-user logins Accounts are monitored in real-time through alert-based mechanisms. API usage Shippers and carriers can define the monitoring frequency as per their needs. How does the system handle unusual login behavior and security threats? SAP Identity Authentication Service triggers alerts at the identity and access layer when it detects unusual behavior, such as excessive requests, failed login attempts, or penetration testing activities. When an alert is generated, the internal operations team is notified and takes corrective actions, such as blocking user access, specific IP addresses, and so on. How does the system detect and flag a compromised carrier account? For real-user logins The SAP Identity Authentication Service triggers alerts for unusual login behavior, prompting further investigation. For API users Shippers and carriers can monitor all incoming and outgoing messages in their SAP Business Network for Logistics tenant using the Manage Integration Logs app and subscribe to alerts for error notifications. What steps are taken once a compromise is identified? If a compromise is detected, the system can perform one of the following actions: For unusual real-user login attempts, the user or IP address may be blocked. For suspicious API usage, shippers and carriers can raise a ticket in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Affected technical user credentials can be disabled, and new credentials issued. To avoid any spurious messages from reaching the shipper, the connection between the shipper and carrier can be temporarily disabled. Are there automated or manual processes to identify suspicious behaviour? A combination of both automated and manual processes are available. For real-user logins, an alert-based monitoring by the SAP Identity Authentication Service team is available. For unusual API usage, manual monitoring options are available to the shippers and carrier. What measures are taken to secure carrier accounts The following security measures are available: 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 40 This is custom documentation. file://api-specs/split/Frequently Asked.content: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and IP whitelisting These are available but disabled by default. These can be enabled at the tenant-level on request. Encryption All transactional data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. Credential security Credentials are encrypted or hashed according to industry best practices. If a data breach occurs due to a leaked carrier account, who is responsible for handling the situation? In case of a data breach, or any other security incident in the carrier tenants, the carriers are the data owners. They will be responsible for handling these situations, with the necessary support from SAP Business Network for Logistics. What support does SAP provide in case of a security breach? Carriers can raise a support ticket in SAP Business Network for Logistics. Depending on the nature of the breach, the following actions can be taken: Disabling compromised API credentials and issue new ones. Blocking unauthorized user access. Restoring tenant access if valid users lose access due to security issues. Disabling the connection between the shipper and carrier temporarily to isolate the shipper system from the affected system. 5/12/26, 6:42 AM 41 This is custom documentation.
