All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetition of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION A message specifying details for goods or services scheduled under conditions agreed between the seller and the buyer. SAP Business Network receives Delivery Schedules from Business Network Buyer in the form of cXML ProductActivityMessage documents. Suppliers are able to select their preferred method of receiving Delivery Schedule. As a service to Suppliers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps to the D.96A DELFOR Delivery schedule message (ProductActivity). Suppliers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for receiving Delivery Schedules. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the ProductActivityMessage are preserved as much as possible in this DELFOR implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Edifact SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 4 of 10 -- DELFOR Delivery schedule message..(ProductActivity based) Outbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.8 May-20, 2025 © 2020-2025 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetitions of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION A message specifying details for goods or services just in time delivery under conditions agreed between the seller and the buyer. SAP Business Network receives Delivery Just in Time messages from Buyer in the form of cXML OrderRequest documents. Suppliers are able to select their preferred method of receiving Delivery Just in Time messages. As a service to Suppliers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps to the D.96A DELJIT Delivery just in time message. Suppliers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for receiving Delivery Just in Times. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the OrderRequest are preserved as much as possible in this DELJIT implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. Example: FTX+AAI+++TEXT 1:TEXT 2:TEXT 3:TEXT 4:TEXT 5+EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Use FTX+ACB to provide more than one general comment with free text type declaration. Example: FTX+ACB+++FREE TEXT TYPE:TEXT 1:TEXT 2:TEXT 3:TEXT 4+EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Note that FTX+ZZZ contains information mutually defined by the trading partner. In this case the first occurrence of 4440 is used as a text identification to specify the mutually defined comments. The transmission of 3453 (language code) is not required. Example: FTX+ZZZ+++Mutually defined identification name:TEXT 1:TEXT 2:TEXT 3:TEXT 4:EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *UserNote (Item Category): Specifies how a component or material is procured. Possible values: "materialUnknown": Refers to procuring a material without specifying the material number. "text": Refers to procuring a free-form text item. "stockTransfer": Refers to transfer of stock from one plant to another. "materialGroup": Refers to procuring a material without specifying the value or quantity. "subcontract": Procuring a material by providing component information to a contract manufacturer that makes the finished product. "consignment": Managing a material through a special process where the payment to supplier is withheld until the material or service is consumed by the buyer. "thirdParty": Procuring a material from a third-party vendor. All rights reserved. 5 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetitions of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION A message specifying details for goods despatched or ready for despatch under agreed conditions. The United Nations Despatch Advice Message serves as a specification for Delivery Despatch Advice message. Throughout this document, the reference to 'Despatch Advice' may be interpreted as conveying the wider meaning of 'Delivery Despatch Advice'. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. All rights reserved. 95 STRUCTURE OF THE DESPATCH ADVICE MESSAGE The message enables a hierarchical description of the shipment by using the CPS segment, starting with the highest level (shipment) and ending with the lowest level (items). It can for example describe a container comprising 2 pallets, a pallet being composed of several large dispatch units which themselves contain smaller dispatch units. The traded units (any level of packaging agreed by the trading partners) are then specified. It is however not mandatory to describe the hierarchical structure of the shipment. A simple and probably most frequent use of the message consists in specifying the items to be dispatched and the relevant information per item (quantity, additional identification ...). -- 5 of 10 -- DESADV Despatch advice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.18 Aug-29, 2025 © 2016-2025 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 96 CONSIGNMENT PACKAGING SEQUENCE (CPS) A group of segments providing details of all package levels and of the individual dispatched items contained in the consignment. This segment group provides the capability to give the hierarchical packing relationships. The group defines a logical top-down order structure. This segment is used to identify the sequence in which packing of the consignment occurs. 7164 Hierarchical structure level identifier - Mandatory Sequential number to identify a level within a hierarchical structure. It starts at 1 for the highest level (shipment) and increments by 1 at each subsequent level. 7166 Hierarchical structure parent identifier - Conditional It is required to refer to the next higher level in a hierarchical structure. Exception: Only the highest level (shipment) has no hierarchical structure parent identifier. 7075 Packaging level code - Optional Code specifying a level of packaging. Can optionally be used. Since the hierarchy and the level structure is identified by 7164 and 7166, 7075 has no influence on the SAP Business Network solution. All rights reserved. 98 SERIAL SHIPPING CONTAINER CODE (SSCC) - UNIQUE PACKAGE IDENTIFICATION It is recommended to use the Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) for unique identification of individual transport packages. Using SSCC enables the transmission of the hierarchical relationship between a child package (e.g carton) and the respective parent package (e.g., pallet) into the ShipNoticeRequest message on SAP Business Network. The SSCC is the GS1 Identification Key used to identify a logistic unit. This unique identifier is comprised of an Extension Digit, a GS1 Company Prefix, a Serial Reference, and a Check Digit. The SSCC can be used to uniquely identify any logistic unit enabling the logistics unit to be correctly identified anywhere in the world. Combined with GS1 Standards for electronic messaging, this "license plate" facilitates simple tracking of goods from the carton level all the way up to the trailer load level and beyond. To see how SSCC works, please refer to the GS1 global website: https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/sscc The SSCC can be sent on 2 different segment groups in the DESADV message, at a GIN segment each (GIN+BJ or GIN+AW) with a preceding PCI segment trigger (PCI+30): SG10(CPS)/SG11(PAC/MEA/QTY)/SG13(PCI)/SG14(GIN) – used for all handling units, all levels SG10/(CPS)/SG15(LIN)/SG20(PCI/MEA/QTY)/SG21(GIN) – only for the material handling units, lowest level SAP Business Network supports the option on the DESADV message to group the lowest packaging level, the material handling units, on either SG10 or SG20 under specific conditions. The grouping of those packages can be used if these conditions are met: ▪ The packaging details are equal (e.g. packaging type, dimensions) ▪ The content is equal (item and item dispatch quantity per package) ▪ All refer to the same parent in the hierarchy (handling unit or consignment) SERIAL SHIPPING CONTAINER CODE (SSCC) EXAMPLES There are 3 options to send the material handling units’ SSCC within the groups SG10 or SG20: 1. These can appear grouped in the message, unlike the package handling units. Conditions: ▪ The packaging details are equal (e.g. packaging type, dimensions) ▪ The content is equal (item and item dispatch quantity per package) ▪ All refer to the same parent in the hierarchy (handling unit or consignment) ASN1: The consignment includes 2 pallets, 2 boxes, 6 cartons and 2 materials / items. The 2nd pallet (2 liters) is identified by SSCC302 and contains The 2nd box (2 liters), identified by SSCC402, which contains 1 carton (1 liter, 1 unit) is identified by SSCC505 and contains Material 1, identified by PART1, and 1 carton (1 liter, 1 unit) is identified by SSCC506 and contains Material 2, identified by PART2. DESADV Example ASN2 All Handling Units (Package and Material) Individually The shipment includes 3 packaging levels with SSCC identification on each handling unit: Highest Packaging Level – Package Handling Unit (Pallet) Middle Packaging Level – Package Handling Unit (BX - Box onto Pallet) Lowest Packaging Level – Material Handling Unit (CT - Carton inside Box) In this situation the material handling units (cartons) can contain multiple materials (items). They appear individually in the message, like the package handling units. ASN2: The consignment includes 2 pallets, 2 boxes, 3 cartons and 3 materials / items. The 1st pallet (200 liters) is identified by SSCC301 and contains The 1st box (200 liters), identified by SSCC401, which contains The 1st carton (100 liters), identified by SSCC501, which contains 50 pieces of Material 1, which is identified by PART1 50 pieces of Material 2, which is identified by PART2 The 2nd carton (100 liters), identified by SSCC502, which contains 50 pieces of Material 1, which is identified by PART1 50 pieces of Material 2, which is identified by PART2. The 2nd pallet (100 liters) is identified by SSCC302 and contains The 2nd box (50 liters), identified by SSCC402, which contains The 3rd carton (50 liters), identified by SSCC503, which contains 50 pieces of Material 2, which is identified by PART2 The 3rd box (50 liters), identified by SSCC403, which contains The 4th carton (50 liters), identified by SSCC504, which contains 50 pieces of Material 2, which is identified by PART2. The last pallet SSCC302, the last box SSCC403 and the last carton SSCC504 have Auxiliary Packaging: Each package has 2 sheets with handling unit identification (SSCC201 – SSCC206) and 1 cover without. The different options to describe the packaging situation of ASN2 in the DESADV are shown in the following sections. All 4 options are presented in an ascending order of complexity or completeness. The illustrations are shortened according to the respective complexity. The boxes are followed by their cartons (material handling units), each by each, which are followed by their contained items with dispatch quantity per carton. The pallets, boxes and cartons are uniquely identified by one SSCC each. The hierarchical structure of the shipment describes the composition of each pallet with its contained boxes and their content (cartons with their contained item(s)). The last pallet SSCC302, the last box SSCC403 and the last carton SSCC504 have Auxiliary Packaging: Each package has 2 sheets with handling unit identification (SSCC201 – SSCC206) and 1 cover without. In this option the shipment is described as composed of: The 1st pallet (SSCC301, 200 liters) contains The 1st box (SSCC401, 200 liters), which contains The 1st carton (SSCC501, 100 liters), which contains 50 pieces of PART1 and 50 pieces of PART2 The 2nd carton (SSCC502, 100 liters), which contains 50 pieces of PART1 and 50 pieces of PART2. The 2nd pallet (SSCC302, 100 liters) has 2 sheets (SSCC201 and SSCC202) and 1 cover. It contains The 2nd box (SSCC402, 50 liters) which contains The 3rd carton (SSCC503, 50 liters), which contains 50 pieces of PART2 The 3rd box (SSCC403, 50 liters), which has 2 sheets (SSCC203 and SSCC204) and 1 cover. It contains The 4th carton (SSCC504, 50 liters), which has 2 sheets (SSCC205 and SSCC206) and 1 cover. It contains 50 pieces of PART2. This option shows the pallets triggered by the shipment segment CPS+1. Supported values are "partial" if all the items are not being shipped or "complete" if the whole order is being shipped. 1004 Document/message number C an..35 C an..35 Shipment identification number (SID) / Despatch advice number An identifier for this particular shipment assigned by the supplier. 1225 Message function, coded C an..3 C an..3 The operational mode of this despatch advice document. 3 Deletion 4 Change (update, future use)* 5 Replace (update, future use)* 9 Original *Note: (4 and 5) are reserved for future use - not supported yet. 4343 Response type, coded C an..3 C an..3 The type of shipment for which this Despatch Advice is created. CA Planned AP Actual Example: BGM+351:ZZZ::partial+Despatch Advice ID+9+CA' A segment by which the sender must uniquely identify the order by means of its name and number and when necessary its function. BGM 1225: The operational mode of a Despatch Advice: An "original" Despatch Advice (9) is the default. This is taken as a new despatch advice message. A "change"/"replace" Despatch Advice (4 or 5) allows a supplier to correct an error in a Despatch Advice or to add additional information learned later. In either case, a "replace"/"change" document must be complete: All data from the original should be discarded by the recipient. A "delete" Despatch Advice (3) removes the changes described in the previous Despatch Advice (either original or a previous replacement) from the state of the shipment. This operation should be used only when the supplier discards a planned shipment or incorrectly sends a Despatch Advice about a shipment that will not take place. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ BGM 1004: Shipment identification number (SID) / Despatch advice number: An "replace"* or "delete" Despatch Advice must have the same SID (1004) as the previous version of the Despatch Advice. This provides an unambiguous and direct connection between all versions of the Despatch Advice. Examples: BGM+351:ZZZ::partial+Original SID1+9+CA' BGM+351:ZZZ::partial+Original SID1+3+CA' In case of delete / cancellation (BGM 1225=3) the original SID value you sent via BGM 1004 will be automatically updated by the SAP Business Network with the attachment of "_1" for further functionality. BGM+351:ZZZ::partial+Original SID1+3+CA' leads to shipmentID value "Original SID1_1" in the SAP Business Network. -- 4 of 10 -- DESADV Despatch advice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.18 Aug-29, 2025 © 2016-2025 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. For further detailed correlation between party and its references please refer to APPENDIX 1153 Reference qualifier, coded. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Examples: Accounts receivable number (AP) can be used with NAD+BY, NAD+IV, NAD+SO, NAD+ST. Example: NAD+IV++Invoicee' RFF+AP:Account Receivable ID' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Internal vendor number (IA) can be used for all supplier related NAD segments. Example: NAD+SU++Supplier' RFF+IA:Internal Supplier ID' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ VAT registration number (VA) is generally used with NAD+FR and NAD+IV. All rights reserved. 25 TOD M 1 Terms of delivery or transport Example: TOD+6+CA+FOB:::Delivery Text 1:Delivery Text 2' A segment indicating the terms of delivery and transfer for the whole Despatch Advice. High level information regarding the terms of delivery address. The address information is specified by a separate NAD segment with entity identifier code (NAD 3035) qualifier as DP. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *(UserNote 4055): You can send your own terms of delivery or transport function by the use of C108/4440_1 of segment FTX+AAR++TDC. Please refer to subsequent segment "FTX Free text”. Example: TOD+6+ZZZ+ZZZ' FTX+AAR++TDC+my own TOD 4055 text' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *(UserNote 4215): You can send your own transport charges method of payment by the use of TOD 4215 = “ZZZ” along with C108/ 4440_1 of segment FTX+AAR++SPM. Please refer to subsequent segment "FTX Free text”. Example: TOD+6+ZZZ+ZZZ' FTX+AAR++SPM+my own TOD 4215 text' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *(UserNote 4053): You can send your own terms of delivery or transport by the use of TOD 4053 = “ZZZ” along with C108/4440_1 of segment FTX+AAR++TTC. Please refer to subsequent segment "FTX Free text”. Example: TOD+6+ZZZ+ZZZ' FTX+AAR++TTC+my own TOD 4053 text' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ TOD C100/4052: Used to specify delivery or transport condition related information (4055 = "5" or "6"). Note: Free text relating to another function than 5 or 6 can be provided via FTX+AAI in SG5 (TOD/FTX). FTX+AAR is used in conjunction with values in C107/4441 as below: "TDC" (TermsOfDelivery function) as a replacement for the related TOD segment, value (4055). "SPM" (ShippingPaymentMethod) as a replacement for the related TOD segment, value (4215 = “ZZZ”). "TTC" (TransportTermsCode) as a replacement for the related TOD segment, value (C100/4053 = “ZZZ”). Example: TOD+6+ZZZ+ZZZ' FTX+AAR++TDC+my own TOD 4055 text' FTX+AAR++SPM+my own TOD 4215 text' FTX+AAR++TTC+my own TOD 4053 text' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ FTX+AAI is used to provide any free text relating to the terms of delivery function (TOD 4055) other than 5 or 6, e.g. for 1=Price condition. Example: TOD+1' FTX+AAI+++PriceCondition Text 1:PriceCondition Text 2:PriceCondition Text 3:PriceCondition Text 4:PriceCondition Text 5+EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ FTX+SSR is used to specify servive level information in free desciption, e. g. All rights reserved. 28 TDT M 1 Details of transport Example: TDT+20+Carrier PRO ID+ZZZ:ShipContractID+31:truck+SCAC::182:Carrier Name++ZZZ:ZZZ:trackingNumber+:::U RL="http?://www.scac.com/xyz' A segment specifying the carriage, and the mode and means of transport of the goods being despatched. If carrier information is being supplied here, both the coded identification (C040/3027+3055) and the carrier name (C040/3128) are always required. Refer to the following LOC segment to specify more details related to this carriage. Example: TDT+20+Carrier PRO ID+ZZZ:ShipContractID+31:truck+SCAC::182:Carrier Name++ZZZ:ZZZ:trackingNumber+:::URL="http?:// www.scac.com/xyz' LOC+ZZZ+:::Shipping Instructions Text 1+:::Shipping Instructions Text 2+:::Shipping Instructions Text 3' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *(UserNote C228/8178): Transport means description: (8051=10 or 80): Possible values for maritime or inland water transport: "cargoVessel": Vessel designed to carry general cargo "unitCarrier": Vessel designed to carry unit loads "bulkCarrier": Vessel designed to carry bulk cargo "tanker": Vessel solely equipped with tanks to carry cargo "liquefiedGasTanker": Tanker designed to carry liquefied gas "otherSpecialTanker": Tanker designed to carry other special liquids "cargoAndPassengerVessel": Vessel designed to carry cargo and passengers "otherVessel": Sea-going vessel, not otherwise specified "fishingBoat": Vessel designed for fishing "floatingStructure": Any floating structure (8051=20): Possible values for rail transport: "train": One or more rail wagons pulled or pushed by one or more locomotive units, or self-propelled, that move over rail tracks "freightTrain": Train for carrying freight (8051=30): Possible values for road transport: "truck": Automotive vehicle designed for hauling loads "tractor": Automotive vehicle with an engine designed for pulling "van": Closed automotive vehicle designed for carrying freight "carCarrier": Automotive vehicle designed for carrying motorcars "shovelLoader": Automotive vehicle designed for shovelling sand and other bulk material "straddleCarrier": Automotive vehicle designed for lifting and transporting containers "mobileCrane": Automotive vehicle with cargo crane "bus": Automotive vehicle designed for carrying more than 8 passengers including the driver "car": Automotive vehicle designed to carry a small number of passengers "taxi": Automotive vehicle licensed to ply for hire (8051=40): The values for air transport are specified in the IATA (International Air Transport Association) publication Standard Schedules Information Manual (SSIM) under the section "ATA/IATA Aircraft Types". The referenced codes cover all aircraft that are flown, or are soon to be flown, for commercial scheduled or chartered services only, or have been announced by the manufacturer and for which airline orders have been placed. (8051=60): When the transport mode is multimodal, this means there are multiple segments, and each may have different mode and means. Therefore, the only possible value is: "unknown" (8051=70): Possible values for fixed transport installations: "unknown": Fixed transport installation of unknown type "pipeline": A line of one or more pipes for continuous transport of liquid or gas commodity "powerline": A line of one or more cables or wires for continuous transport of electricity _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *User Note (Carrier URL): Depending upon the length of the carrier URL address and your preference you can use either TDT C222/8212 or the subsequent LOC C517/3224 (where LOC 3227=92) or both in combination. If you use the combination, it is required to enter the first part of the carrier URL address into the TDT segment and the second part into the LOC segment. Code 304 is recommended. Please refer for special requirements and time zone usage to APPENDIX - CODELISTS 2379 Date/time/period format qualifier. 102 CCYYMMDD 203 CCYYMMDDHHMM 204 CCYYMMDDHHMMSS 303 CCYYMMDDHHMMZZZ 304 CCYYMMDDHHMMSSZZZ Example: DTM+171:20160111093000P00:304' This segment is used to specify the date and time related to the Tracking Number in TDT 8028 and/or in LOC C517/3224. Date/Time Note: Note that a complete date/time/zone is recommended. Otherwise it will be automatically calculated and might lead to wrong data. Timestamps in cXML are represented as a date with a time, and an offset to UTC. If you do not specify a time, it will be taken as noon (12:00) on the date specified. The time code (zone) will be defaulted to UTC (+00:00). _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Examples: TDT+20+Carrier Track ID+ZZZ:ShipContractID+31:truck+SCAC::182:Carrier Name++ZZZ:ZZZ:trackingNumber' LOC+92+:::URL-35-Chars-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' DTM+171:20160111093000P00:304' or TDT+20+Carrier Track ID+ZZZ:ShipContractID+31:truck+SCAC::182:Carrier Name++ZZZ:ZZZ:trackingNumber+:::URL-35-Chars- xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx' LOC+92' DTM+171:20160111093000P00:304' -- 1 of 10 -- DESADV Despatch advice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.18 Aug-29, 2025 © 2016-2025 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. Use 7405 = "BN" for a serial number of an asset and/or 7405 = "AP" for a tag number of an asset. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ When a serial number and a tag number belong to the same asset, you have to use one GIR segment for both. You can use the first position (C_206_1) for the serial number and the second position (C_206_2) for the tag number or vice versa. You can use one GIR segment either with one or with two positions (C_206) for the same purpose. All rights reserved. 71 RFF M 1 Reference Example: RFF+LI:2::item' A segment identifying documents or identification numbers related to the line item. RFF+ON: The original Purchase order number from BGM 1004 in the ORDERS message is mandatory. It must be used with DTM+171 or DTM+4 to provide the required order date. It can be used either in header SG1 if the Despatch Advice refers to a single Purchase Order or in item SG16 if multiple Purchase Orders are referenced. Example: RFF+ON:Purchase Order ID' DTM+171:20160104093000P00:304' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ RFF+CT: The Contract/Agreement number should be used with DTM+171 or DTM+126 to provide the Contract/Agreement date. Note: The Contract/Agreement number should be used in dependency with RFF+ON either on header SG1 or on item SG16. Example: RFF+CT:Agreement ID:1' DTM+171:20160104083000P00:304' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ RFF+LI is used to specify the type and hierarchy of an item. The Parent line number (C506/1154) refers to the line number of the corresponding parent line item. This is a mandatory field and applicable only for a line item with Item type (C506/4000) = "item". Item type (C506/4000) specifies whether the line item is a grouped item having child items, an independent line item or a lean item. Possible values: "composite" to identify an item group (parent) "item" to identify an independent line item (child) "lean" to identify that no child item is expected for the line Example no item hierarchy: LIN+1++10:PL' RFF+LI:::lean' Example item hierarchy: LIN+1++10:PL' RFF+LI:::composite' LIN+2++10:PL+1:1' RFF+LI:1::item' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ RFF+ZZZ contains information mutually defined by the trading partner. In this case 1154 is used as identification name to specify the mutually defined usage provided in 4000. Please note RFF 4000 is not required. For various business cases it is sufficient to transmit only the mutually defined identification by itself. E.g. to activate a special handling or operation. Example: RFF+ZZZ:MutuallyDefinedIDName' RFF+ZZZ:MutuallyDefinedIDName::Mutually defined identification' -- 1 of 10 -- DESADV Despatch advice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.18 Aug-29, 2025 © 2016-2025 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetitions of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION SAP Business Network sends Transport Instruction Messages by means of the cXML TransportRequest document conform to its rules. As a service to Logistic Service Providers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps to the D.96A IFTMIN Instruction Message. Logistic Service Providers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for receiving Instruction Messages. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the cXML TransportRequest document are preserved as much as possible in this IFTMIN implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Usage SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 4 of 10 -- IFTMIN Instruction message Outbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.5 Jun-17, 2024 © 2017-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 22 RFF M 1 Reference Example: RFF+CN:Carrier Shipment ID::trackingNumber' A segment to express a reference which applies to the entire message. REF+UCN: Unique consignment reference number The Unique consignment reference number is always required and must be returned in the transport confirmation IFTSTA via CNI/ C503/1004. It is the mandatory and unique identifier for this consignment, which is a collection of packages going from a single originating party to a single destination party. The collection of packages or consignment items are specified in detail via SG18/GID. Example: RFF+UCN:Consignment ID' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ RFF+CN: Shipment identifier information This segment can be used in up to two different ways. If already known it can be used to identify the carrier assigned shipment identifier in C506/1154 and date with DTM+85. In this case C506/4000 specifies the related type or domain, e.g. trackingNumber. An additional RFF+CT segment can be used to provide the URL of the related tracking number. In this case C506/4000 is always set to "TrackingURL". Examples: RFF+CN:Carrier Shipment ID::trackingNumber' DTM+85:201601111300:203' and RFF+CN:Tracking URL Text::TrackingURL' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Special reference numbers and dates related to this transport request and the transport logistic process chain: RFF+SI: The SID (Shipper's identifying number for shipment) is used with DTM+171. RFF+BM: The Bill of lading number is used with DTM+95. RFF+AAO: The Consignee's shipment reference number is used with DTM+171. Examples: RFF+SI:SID' DTM+171:201601111300:203' RFF+BM:Bill Of Lading ID' DTM+95:201601111300:203' RFF+AAO:Consignee Reference ID' DTM+171:201601111500:203' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Optional document message numbers and dates from former messages related to this transport request within the whole process chain and further optional reference numbers and dates related to former messages, such as: RFF+CT: The Agreement number is used with DTM+126. RFF+ON: The Order number (purchase) is used with DTM+4 to relate to a former ORDERS. RFF+VN: The Order number (vendor) is used with DTM+4. RFF+MA: The Ship notice/manifest number is used with DTM+111 to relate to a former DESADV. RFF+DQ: The Delivery note number is used with DTM+124. RFF+IV: The Invoice number is used with DTM+3 to relate to a former INVOIC. All rights reserved. 31 SG18 M 999 Goods item details GID M 1 Goods item details Standard Usage SAP Business Network Usage 1496 Goods item number C n..5 M n..5 Goods item line number C213 Number and type of packages C M 7224 Number of packages C n..8 M n..8 Number of (outer) packages* *User Note (C213) 7065 Type of packages identification C an..17 X 1131 Code list qualifier C an..3 X 3055 Code list responsible agency, coded C an..3 X 7064 Type of packages C an..35 C an..35 Type of (outer) packages* *User Note (C213) C213 Number and type of packages C C 7224 Number of packages C n..8 C n..8 Number of inner packages* *User Note (C213) 7065 Type of packages identification C an..17 X 1131 Code list qualifier C an..3 X 3055 Code list responsible agency, coded C an..3 X 7064 Type of packages C an..35 C an..35 Type of inner packages* *User Note (C213) Example: GID+1+2::::Pallet+4::::Box' A segment to identify a goods item for which transport is undertaken. Goods items are the line details of this consignment. Note: Packaging details are not mandatory and the packaging code (C213/7064) is optional in this segment. The Packaging code (C213/7064) becomes mandatory only if any other packaging related information is used, e.g. packaging measurements and dimensions (SG20/MEA), packaging shipping marks, packaging identification numbers (SG23/PCI/RFF/GIN). _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *User Note (C213): A goods item can be identified by up to two levels of packaging. If packaging hierarchy exists, the first segment group C213 is used to identify the outer or parent level of packaging by at least the number of outer packages. In this case the second segment group C213 is required to identify the related inner or child level of packaging. Example two levels of packaging: GID+1+2::::Pallet+4::::Box' In case of simple packaging structure only the first segment group C213 is used to identify the packaging without hierarchical dependency by at least the number of packages in general. Example simple packaging: GID+1+2::::Pallet' or GID+1+4::::Box' -- 1 of 10 -- IFTMIN Instruction message Outbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.5 Jun-17, 2024 © 2017-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. EN English Example: FTX+AAI+++TEXT1:TEXT2:TEXT3:TEXT4:TEXT5+EN' A segment to specify processable supplementary information relating to the goods item. FTX+AAI is used for general comments. Example: FTX+AAI+++general text1:general text2:general text3:general text4:general text5+EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Hazard information: If hazard information is used, both FTX+HAZ and FTX+AAC are present. FTX+HAZ is used for general dangerous goods description. FTX+AAC is used for additional dangerous goods classification. In this case the first occurrence of 4440 is used as a text identification to specify the domain responsible for classification and the transmission of 3453 (language code) is not required. Examples: FTX+HAZ+++Hazard Description1:Hazard Description2:Hazard Description3:Hazard Description4:Hazard Description5:EN' FTX+AAC+++Domain:Hazard Classification1' or FTX+HAZ+++Flammable liquids, toxic, n.o.s:::::EN' FTX+AAC+++UNDG:1992' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Mutually defined information: FTX+ZZZ contains information mutually defined by the trading partner. In this case the first occurrence of 4440 is used as a text identification to specify the mutually defined comments. In this case the transmission of 3453 (language code) is not required. All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetition of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION SAP Business Network receives International Multimodal Status Report Message by means of the cXML TransportConfirmation document conform to its rules. As a service to Logistic Service Providers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps from the D.96A IFTSTA Instruction message. Logistic Service Providers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for sending International Multimodal Status Report Messages. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the TransportRequest are preserved as much as possible in this IFTMIN implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Usage SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 4 of 10 -- IFTSTA International multimodal status report message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.5 Jun-17, 2024 © 2017-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 22 STS M 1 Status Example: STS++69+3:::Rejection Reason' A segment specifying the status relating to a consignment (e.g. loaded). STS/C555/9011=72: Use status "Accepted" if the Transport request IFTMIN is fully accepted. STS/C555/9011=13: Use status "Collected" if the requested consignment is collected and ready to be shipped. It is possible but not necessary to return information from the Transport request IFTMIN, e.g. reference numbers. It is recommended to provide updated or new information, such as Carrier reference number and tracking information (RFF+CN), free text information (FTX), transport related dates (SG6/TDT/DTM) and/or equipment information (SG7/EQD). Example Accepted: STS++72' RFF+CN:Carrier Shipment ID::trackingNumber' RFF+CN:Tracking URL Text::TrackingURL' DTM+85:201601111300:203' FTX+ZZZ+++MutuallyDefinedIDName:Mutually Defined ID TEXT1:TEXT2:TEXT3:TEXT4' TDT+12' DTM+133:20160112111500P00:304' TDT+13' DTM+17:20160113120000P00:304' EQD+TE+Trailer ID++2++4' Example Collected: STS++13' RFF+CN:Carrier Shipment ID::trackingNumber' RFF+CN:Tracking URL Text::TrackingURL' DTM+85:201601111300:203' FTX+ZZZ+++MutuallyDefinedIDName:Mutually Defined ID TEXT1:TEXT2:TEXT3:TEXT4' TDT+12' DTM+133:20160112111500P00:304' TDT+13' DTM+35:20160113121000P00:304' EQD+TE+Trailer ID++2++4' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ STS/C555/9011=7: Use status "Cancelled" if the Transport request IFTMIN is cancelled for any reason. In this case no further optional content is required, but it is recommended to add the cancelation reason via free text (FTX+ACD). Example Cancelled: STS++7' FTX+ACD+++Goods are still in production:Not ready to pick up:Cancelation Reason TEXT3:TEXT4:TEXT5+EN' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ STS/C555/9011=69: Use status "Rejected" if the requested consignment can't be executed for a specific reason. *User Note (Rejected): In this case C556 becomes mandatory. 9013 must be "3" and 9012 must be the Rejection reason. No further optional content is required, but it is recommended to add the rejection reason via free text (FTX+ACD). Example Rejected: STS++69+3:::ExceedsServiceLimitation' FTX+ACD+++Carton lenghts exceeds 4 mtr:Pick-up refused:Rejection Reason TEXT3:TEXT4:TEXT5+EN' -- 2 of 10 -- IFTSTA International multimodal status report message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.5 Jun-17, 2024 © 2017-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. In this case C506/4000 should specify the related type or domain, e.g. trackingNumber. An additional RFF+CT segment can be used to provide the URL of the related tracking number. All rights reserved. 5 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e. the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetition of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION A message claiming payment for goods or services supplied under conditions agreed between the seller and the buyer. The United Nations Standard Invoice Message, with correct data qualification, serves also as the specification for Debit Note and Credit Note messages. Throughout this document, the reference to 'Invoice' may be interpreted as conveying the wider meaning of 'Invoice/Credit Note/Debit Note'. SAP Business Network implements invoices with the cXML InvoiceDetailRequest document. The INVOIC implementation must ultimately map to an InvoiceDetailRequest and conform to its rules. There are two layout templates of invoices: Detailed (Regular Invoice) and Header (Summary Invoice). A regular invoice addresses the line items of one purchase order. A summary invoice covers many purchase orders without listing specific line items. There are three types of invoices: Standard, Credit Memo and Debit Memo. Each layout template and invoice type has particular requirements: content that must be present in order to be valid. There are also some content requirements for INVOIC itself to be satisfied. This document is intended to assist suppliers to start testing INVOIC messaging with the minimal requirements. It addresses the base data content for the invoice and what must be included in an INVOIC message. This document does not attempt to explain how every possible cXML construct is represented in the INVOIC. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Edifact SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 5 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-02, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 6 VALUE-ADDED TAXATION (VAT), TRIANGULAR TRANSACTIONS, TAX REGIME AND TAX EXEMPTION UPDATE: Version 2.17 Mar-02, 2026 The Tax Point Date and Payment Date are now also collected if the tax category is Goods Service Tax (GST). SAP Business Network Invoicing supports Value-Added Tax (VAT) charges, taxation of Triangular Transactions, which is a requirement within Europe, and a Tax regime classification This section addresses the complex mapping required to implement such data in the INVOIC. As mentioned earlier, all EDI data inbound to SAP Business Network must ultimately be translated to cXML before it can be finally processed by the network and routed to SAP Business Network Buyer. The section of elements being addressed here are Tax, TaxDetail, TriangularTransactionLawReference and TaxRegime. A Contact role of Ultimate Customer has been added to represent the party ultimately purchasing the goods. This is covered in NAD SG2, where NAD/3035="UD". Within the NAD group, RFF with qualifier “VA” can be used to provide a VAT Registration Number for partners involved in the transaction. The top-level Tax element in cXML itself requires a simple description with a total monetary amount. The total tax amount is implemented with SG48, where MOA/C516/5025=”124” or “176” for the header level (invoice summary totals), and SG26, where MOA/C516/5025=“176” for the line item level. Tax description in turn, is covered with FTX/4451=”TXD” for the header and line item level (item SG25). One or more TaxDetail elements can be provided within Tax to detail the tax charge breakdown. At the header level, each occurrence of TAX SG50 produces one TaxDetail structure. If only one tax rate applies, TAX SG6 can be used instead. Tax details are also supported at the line-item level with TAX SG33. VAT with Triangular Transactions involves integrating four things with a Tax Detail: 1. Tax Point Date, which refers to the date on which VAT/GST becomes due. 2. Payment Date, which indicates the date when payment must be made. 3. Triangular Transaction indicator, that this VAT tax charge represents a triangular transaction. 4. Triangular Transaction Law Reference, a text string identifying the relevant triangulation law for the transaction. Since these data are not provided within the TAX group, they must be gathered from neighbouring segments within the INVOIC. To implement this, the TAX segment must have a category of VAT. TAX/3446 contains the relevant matching key. An RFF group with qualifier VA contains the same matching key (SG1 for header and SG29 for line-item level tax). This is how the RFF group is connected to the TAX group. The RFF group contains one of both DTM segments with qualifiers “131” and “140” to provide the dates. (Points 1 & 2 above.) TAX/C533/5289 may optionally contain the code "TT", which tags it as a Triangular Transaction. (Point 3 above.) The Triangular Transaction Law Reference (Point 4 above) requires a long string that only the FTX segment can support. To cover the special case of a Triangular Transaction in the INVOIC, FTX/4451 is set to "TXD" and FTX/4453 is set to “4” (Used at main header and line-item level SG25). The text function code “4” is important to separate from general tax descriptions mentioned above. When this is set, FTX is read differently. FTX/C108 provides an array of Law Reference strings. To attach a particular reference string to a TAX group we go back to the RFF group providing the dates. If the TAX is marked as a Triangular Transaction, then RFF/1156 is read as an index to FTX/C108 which has five (5) components (4440), so DE1156 contains an integer value of 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5. FTX/3453 defines the language code. Any supported language may be used. -- 6 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-02, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 7 Several conditions must be true for this to work: 1. TAX segment must have a category of VAT. TAX/C241/5153="VAT". 2. TAX segment must have a matching key for the relevant party in TAX/3446. 3. RFF segment must have a qualifier of VA. RFF/1153="VA". 4. RFF segment must have the same matching key in RFF/1154. These four conditions are required to associate Tax Point Date and Payment Due Date with the Tax Detail. Additionally, the following four conditions must also be true to merge a Law Reference: 5. TAX must indicate a Triangular Transaction. TAX/C533/5289="TT". 6. FTX must qualify itself as a Tax declaration. FTX/4451) = "TXD". 7. FTX must provide one or more Law Reference strings in FTX/C108/4440. 8. RFF must identify a string to capture from FTX's C108 in RFF/1156. To implement the Tax regime, it is required to provide a matching key in TAX/3446. The value has to match to the RFF/1154 with qualifier AHR (SG1 for header and SG29 for line-item level tax). This is how the RFF group is connected to the TAX group and the RFF/4000 is generated as TaxRegime. To implement Tax Exemption details, it is required to provide a matching key in TAX/3446. The value has to match to the FTX/C108/4440_1 where FTX/4451=”TXD” and FTX/4453=”3” (SG25/FTX for line-item level tax). This is how the FTX group is connected to the TAX group. Value used in the TAX/3446 element as a matching key will be used only for the matching purpose and won’t be mapped. Therefore, to generate a Tax description, it is necessary to provide an RFF+VA segment with the same matching key in RFF/1154. In summary, there are six levels of detail that can be implemented for a tax charge. All levels are supported at both header and line items. 1. Summary tax with a description and an amount. 2. Detailed breakdown of tax charges, including VAT. 3. Tax Point and Payment Due dates for VAT/GST tax charges. 4. Triangulation Law Reference for VAT tax charges. 5. Tax Regime classification for tax charges. 6. Tax Exemption details for tax charges. -- 7 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-02, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 101 NAD M 1 Name and address Example: NAD+CA+CA-ID::92+Contact Name+Postal Address Name+Street+City+CsubID+Postcode+US' A segment identifying names and adresses of the parties, in coded or clear form, and their functions relevant to the order. If either NAD+SF or NAD+ST is used, then the other is required. If NAD+CA is used, then NAD+SF and NAD+ST are both required. MF is used with regular invoices only, and is paired with MF in C212, in PIA. They must be used together. Note that only the Name (C058/3124) is actually required. If the name to be provided exceed the maximum field length of 35 characters, element 3036 can be repeated. The name is then chained in the network. The postal address is optional in itself and not required with most NAD groups, but it is recommended for NAD+SF and particularly NAD+ST if used. If any element from a Postal Address (NAD C080 - NAD 3207) is being provided, then Street (C059/3042), City (3164) and the two- char ISO-3166 Country code (3207) are all required and become mandatory. If the country code (3207) is US or CA, then the country-sub-entity (3229) is also required and must be a valid state or province digraph. Within a postal address, party name (C080/3036) is supposed to represent specific recipient name(s) of a package or envelope. This may also include intra-office routing information, such as a department, a floor, office, or cube number. Use of party name (C080/3036) is entirely optional. -- 1 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-03, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. That option should be reserved for cases in which additional detail about the carrier are required. Possible values with NAD+SF / NAD+ST: E.g. All rights reserved. 104 RFF M 1 Reference - Additional carrier/shipment identification Example: RFF+CN:Tracking ID::trackingNumber' A segment identifying the reference by its number and where appropriate a line number within a document. This reference is used only with NAD+CA or NAD+SF and NAD+ST. If it is paired with NAD+CA it provides the carrier identification number. If it is used with NAD+SF and NAD+ST it identify the carrier assigned reference number for their part of the shipment (shipment tracking number). In addition to this, DTM+89 can be used to provide a shipment tracking date. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Carrier identification number: This RFF can provide multiple identifiers for the same carrier. The use of an identification domain is required. All identification provided by RFF+CN must correspond to the same company. Example: NAD+CA++Carrier' RFF+CN:Legal company name::companyName' RFF+CN:Carrier ID-1::SCAC' RFF+CN:Carrier ID-2::DUNS' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Carrier assigned reference number: Identifier that appears on this shipment and through which additional detail about the shipment may be retrieved. Defined by the carrier. Conceptually, this is a tracking number. Different carriers have different names for shipment identifiers. Some call it a way bill number, others call it a PRO number, and still others call it a bill of lading. They all represent tracking numbers. To specify more precisely what kind of identifier this is, a domain can apply. Example: NAD+SF++Ship-from' RFF+CN:Tracking ID-1::trackingNumber' DTM+89:20160203:102' RFF+CN:Tracking ID-2::billOfLading' DTM+89:20160203:102' -- 4 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-03, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. Please refer for special requirements and time zone usage to APPENDIX - CODELISTS 2379 Date/time/period format qualifier. 102 CCYYMMDD 203 CCYYMMDDHHMM 204 CCYYMMDDHHMMSS 303 CCYYMMDDHHMMZZZ 304 CCYYMMDDHHMMSSZZZ Example: DTM+89:20160101:102' A segment specifying the date/time related to the reference. Date/Time Note: Note that a complete date/time/zone is recommended. Otherwise it will be automatically calculated and might lead to wrong data. Timestamps in cXML are represented as a date with a time, and an offset to UTC. If you do not specify a time, it will be taken as noon (12:00) on the date specified. If you do not specify the time code (zone), then it will be defaulted to UTC (+00:00). _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Only used with NAD+SF and NAD+ST in association with RFF+CN. -- 5 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-03, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. If the special service description to be provided exceed the maximum field length of 35 characters, element 7160 can be repeated. The description is then chained in the network. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *UserNote (C214/7161): It is recommended to use the special service description code in addition to the mandatory allowance or charge indicator 5463=A/C. In case no pecification is available please use ACA for allowance or ABK for charge. Examples: ALC+A++++ACA' MOA+8:10.00:EUR:4' ALC+C++++ABK' MOA+8:10.00:EUR:4' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ In this example, a 10% allowance representing a price change of 9.90 Euro. Original price: 99.00 Euro Deducted price: 89.10 Euro ALC+A++++ACA' RFF+ZZZ:Allowance-Description:EN' DTM+194:20160101:102' DTM+206:20160201:102' PCD+3:10:13' MOA+98:99,00:EUR:4' MOA+4:89.10:EUR:4' In this example, a 8% volume discount representing 80.00 Euros is being offered. ALC+A++++VAB' RFF+ZZZ:Volume-Discount-Description:EN' DTM+194:20160101:102' DTM+206:20160201:102' PCD+3:8:13' MOA+8:80.00:EUR:4' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ In this example, a 10% freight fee representing 120.00 Euros is being charged. All rights reserved. 133 TAX M 1 Duty/tax/fee details Example: TAX+7+VAT:::Tax location++1000.00+AN:::12.00+E+Tax Description' A segment specifying the tax type to be summarized. This TAX is used to transmit summarized tax amounts per tax rate given in MOA+124 (SG50) in an invoice. This includes all taxes on line-items as well as taxes on allowances and charges at both the header-level and line-item level. TAX/MOA group can be repeated if multiple tax rates apply to one invoice (see example below). All single MOA+124 (SG50) should add up to the message total tax amount specified in MOA+176 (SG48). All rights reserved. 134 TAX M 1 Duty/tax/fee details For alternate Tax amount and Taxable amount TAX group can be repeated with same Tax type and percecntage. Alternate amounts and currencies should be provided in the MOA segment in second TAX group with qualifier "7" in MOA_6343 field For example, alternate Tax and Taxable amount along with currency for "VAT" type and 12% can be provided as below. Example: TAX+7+VAT++1000.00+:::12.00+S' MOA+124:90.20:EUR:4' MOA+125:474.72:EUR:4' TAX+7+VAT+++:::12.00' MOA+124:96.18:USD:7' MOA+125:506.18:USD:7' _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *UserNote (TaxDate): If TAX/C241/5153="VAT", then TAX/3446 is matched to RFF/C506/1154 (SG1) where RFF/C506/1153="VA" to search for a matching key. If a tax point date and payment date are supplied in the RFF group, then they will be associated accordingly. *UserNote (TT): If suppliers wants to specify custom tax detail description, then they can use TAX/3446 for the same. If TAX/C241/5153="VAT" and TAX/C533/5289="TT", and TAX/3446 is used as a matching key for an RFF group (where SG1 RFF/ C506/1153="VA") to capture a related tax point date and payment due date for the VAT of a triangular transaction, then suppliers can specify the Tax Detail description in RFF/C506/4000. *UserNote (Tax regime): If suppliers wants to specify a tax regime, then they can use TAX/3446 for the same. TAX/3446 is used as a matching key for an RFF group (where SG1 RFF/C506/1153="AHR") to capture a related tax regime. Suppliers can specify the Tax regime in RFF/C506/4000. *UserNote (TaxExemption): If suppliers needs to specify tax exemption details, then they can use TAX/3446 for the same. TAX/3446 is used as a matching key for an FTX group (where FTX/4451="TXD" and FTX/4453="3") to capture related tax exemption details. Suppliers can specify tax exemption code values in FTX/C108/4440_2 and tax exemption reason in FTX/C108/4440_3- 4440_5. Refer to the section "VALUE-ADDED TAXATION (VAT), TRIANGULAR TRANSACTIONS, TAX REGIME AND TAX EXEMPTION" for additional details on implementing this advanced feature. -- 4 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-03, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. This segment is used to specify the summary of all allowances and charges (per special service type) applied on the goods and services at the line item level. Excluded service types are: ADT (Distribution), DI (Discount), SAA (Shipping and handling) and SH (Special handling service). All rights reserved. 154 APPENDIX – CODELISTS 2379 Date/time/period format qualifier The following codes are supported. 102 CCYYMMDD Calendar date 203 CCYYMMDDHHMM Calendar date including time with minutes 204 CCYYMMDDHHMMSS Calendar date including time with seconds 303 CCYYMMDDHHMMZZZ See 203 plus time zone (ZZZ) 304 CCYYMMDDHHMMSSZZZ See 204 plus time zone (ZZZ) C=Century; Y=Year; M=Month; D=Day; H=Hour; M=Minute; S=Second; Z=Timezone Note that a complete date/time/zone is recommended. If you do not specify a time, it may be taken as midnight on the date specified. If you do not specify a time zone, then it will be defaulted to GMT. The recommended codes for time zones (the ZZZ part) are to use the ISO-8601 codes +nn, -nn. However, since + is a restricted character, Pnn and Mnn codes are implemented to specify the hour offset from UTC. P = Plus, M = Minus. P01 = +01:00, P02 = +02:00 ... M01 = -01:00, M02 = -02:00, etc. P00 = +00:00, M00 = -00:00, GMT = UT = +00:00 P12 = +12:00, M12 = -12:00, though they are equivalent. 3207 Country, coded *Note that SAP Business Network supports codes from higher EDIFACT versions. All rights reserved. 18 BGM M 1 Beginning of message Example: BGM+380:::Document-Name+INVOIC ID+9' A segment by which the sender must uniquely identify the order by means of its name and number and when necessary its function. There are two layout templates of invoices: Regular and Header. A Regular Invoice addresses the line items of one purchase order. A Header Invoice covers many purchase orders without listing specific line items. There are three types of invoices: Standard [C002/1001="380"/"385"], Credit Memo [C002/1001="381"/"81"] and Debit Memo [C002/1001="383"/"80"]. Consolidated Invoices must use the Regular layout template. A Credit Memo submitted in Regular form is called "Line Level Credit Memo", a Debit Memo submitted in Regular form is called "Line Level Debit Memo". Both include item details. Header Invoices reference one whole Purchase Order on each line item of the invoice. The line items of each Purchase Order are not detailed. Each Purchase Order being covered in a Header Invoice requires an occurrence of Group 25: LIN. At the line item level, we simply use Group 29: Reference the same way we used the header level Group 1: Reference. The requirements are the same. Regular Invoices are identified by specifying order and/or master agreement identifications at the invoice header level. Used with BGM/C002/1001="380" (Standard Invoice), BGM/C002/1001="385" (Standard Consolitated Invoice), BGM/C002/ 1001="81" (Line Level Credit Memo) and BGM/C002/1001="80" (Line Level Debit Memo). Header Invoices are identified by NOT specifying any order and/or master agreement identifications at the invoice header level. Used with BGM/C002/1001="380" (Standard Invoice), BGM/C002/1001="381" (Credit Memo) and BGM/C002/1001="383" (Debit Memo). In case the INVOIC is a Credit Memo or Line Level Credit Memo, SAP Business Network will default all amounts to negative. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Example: Standard Invoice (Regular form) BGM+380:::+Invoice-001+9' ... The postal address is optional in itself and not required with most NAD groups, but it is recommended for NAD+SF and particularly NAD+ST if used. If any element from a Postal Address (NAD C080 - NAD 3207) is being provided, then Street (C059/3042), City (3164) and the two- char ISO-3166 Country code (3207) are all required and become mandatory. If the country code (3207) is US or CA, then the country-sub-entity (3229) is also required and must be a valid state or province digraph. Within a postal address, party name (C080/3036) is supposed to represent specific recipient name(s) of a package or envelope. This may also include intra-office routing information, such as a department, a floor, office, or cube number. Use of party name (C080/3036) is entirely optional. The final recipient of goods (NAD+UD) is used for reporting Value-Added Tax (VAT) in a "Triangular Transaction". This party may be used with RFF (SG3) with qualifier VA ("VAT registration number"). -- 4 of 10 -- INVOIC Invoice message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 2.17 Mar-03, 2026 © 2016-2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. The usage of tax details in itself is optional. But if tax details apply, it is required to use TAX+9++++++Tax Description' with MOA+176 to provide the total tax amount of the current modification in conjunction with details about the specific type of tax (TAX, with MOA+124). Please note that the usage of a tax description (TAX/3446) is required. The sum of all MOA+124 should match the total tax amount in MOA+176. The usage of a tax detail description (TAX details with MOA+124) is optional. PIA 4347=1 (additional information) should be used only with: Classification (UNSPSC) (CC) EAN number (EN) Serial number (SN) UPC (Universal product code) (UP) European waste catalog number (ZZZ) Vendor's supplemental item number (VS) PIA 4347=5 (product information) should be used only with: Buyer's part number (BP) Manufacturer's article number (MF) Supplier's article / Vendor item number (VN) or (SA) _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Commodity classification of the service (CC) Typically lists the UNSPSC (United Nations Standard Products and Services Code) commodity code for each selected item. These codes are used by backend systems within buyer and supplier organizations for accounting and report generation. For the list of UNSPSC codes, see www.unspsc.org. If custom classificiations are required, please use IMD item description segment (IMD+B++ACA). _____________________________________________________________________________________________ Item number identifiers may optionally be specified to indicate exactly what is being invoiced. Item numbers may be specified in any sequence. Manufacturer's part ID (MF) is paired with NAD+MF. They are optional, but must both be used together. To specify the vendor / supplier assigned item identification both can be used, VN or SA. If vendor's supplemental item (VS) is used, then VN or SA is required. VN or SA does not require VS. Serial numbers (SN) are allowed to repeat. This is useful for high-priced commodities, in which a serial number must be specified for each item shipped. All rights reserved. 81 MOA M 1 Monetary amount Example: MOA+128:100.00:EUR:4' A segment specifying any monetary amounts relating to the product, e.g. item amount. Subtotal amount (MOA+289) The invoice subtotal of the current line item (unit price times quantity). The alternate invoice subtotal of the current line item (unit price times quantity). SG26 MOA/C516/6343="7" to be used to denote alternate amount and currency. Optional for regular and summary invoices but mandatory for service items. Tax amount (MOA+176) The tax amount for the current line item (including taxes on shipping, and special handling charges). The alternate tax amount for the current line item (including taxes on shipping, and special handling charges). SG26 MOA/C516/ 6343="7" to be used to denote alternate amount and currency. Optional for regular and summary invoices. Gross amount (MOA+128) The sum of subtotal, taxes, special handling, shipping and all other charges for the current line item, before discounts. Optional for regular and summary invoices. Net amount (MOA+203 / MOA+38) The gross amount minus allowances and discounts for the current line item. MOA+203 is used to provide net amount for regular invoices only. MOA+38 is used to provide net amount for summary invoices only. Optional for regular and summary invoices. Total charges amount (MOA+259) The total sum of all the charges applied on the goods and services. Total allowances amount (MOA+260) The total sum of all the allowances applied on the goods and services. Total line item amount without tax - (MOA+125). This element is used to summarize the total line item amount without tax. The total amount represents sum of subtotal, total charges (including special handling charges and shipping charges), and total allowances (including discounts - ALC+A++++DI'). This does not include taxes. _____________________________________________________________________________________________ *UserNote (146): Unit price (MOA+146) The unit price for the current line item. Mandatory for regular invoices. Not used for summary invoices. Please use SG28 (Price details) to provide e.g. price basis quatity or measurement unit. Please refer to "APPENDIX – SPECIAL USAGE OF SOME EDIFACT GROUPS / SEGMENTS / DATA ELEMENTS" *User Note alternate amount For alternate amount for the current line item use SG26 MOA/C516/6343="7". All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetitions of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION A message from the seller to the buyer, responding to a purchase order message or a purchase order change request message. The United Nations Order Response Message serves as response/confirmation for the Purchase Order and Purchase Order Change messages. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. With a response type of “AC”, you can update portions of a purchase order, such as prices, quantities, and delivery dates, reject portions, and add tax and shipping information. This document type should include only information that differs from the information in the purchase order. Line items not mentioned retain their current states. *UserNote: If the "Enhanced order confirmation integration capabilities for hosted and integrated suppliers“ entitlement is enabled by the buyer in SAP Business Network, the supplier must include all known line item information in the order confirmation. This special type takes priority over used response type code and will be flagged in the network. If the entitlement is on, it means that the confirmation updates only specific line items. Line items not mentioned retain their current status. Unlike the "AC" type, this type of confirmation includes all information known by the supplier, whether or not it differs from the data provided in the original purchase order document. There is no enrichment of data sent by the supplier. If not all necessary line item information are sent the document will fail. The above entitlement setting or usage of confirmation type "AC" update individual lines, they do not accept or reject the entire order. You can apply the confirmation to the entire purchase order using the types “AP”, “RE”, and “AI”. Response type "AI" accepts the entire purchase order with exceptions. Line items not mentioned are as described in the purchase order. -- 2 of 10 -- ORDRSP Purchase order response message Inbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.11 Oct-25, 2024 © 2017-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e., the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetition of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION SAP Business Network receives Receiving Advice with the cXML ReceiptRequest document. The RECADV implementation must ultimately map to an ReceiptRequest and conform to its rules. As a service to Suppliers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps to the D.96A RECADV Receiving Advice message. Suppliers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for receiving Receiving Advice. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the ReceiptRequest are preserved as much as possible in this RECADV implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Usage SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 4 of 10 -- RECADV Receiving advice message Outbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.2 Feb-28, 2023 © 2017-2023 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company. All rights reserved. 4 PREFACE This document outlines the requirements for digital data interchange using the Edifact format. Initially the used segments and their meaning within a message are described. The example files used in this guide are examples only. In the following chapter all segments are described in detail. Additionally, you will find a document example as well as a branching diagram. This documentation focuses on an explicit version, i.e. the segments are documented as they would possibly occur in practice. Thus, the maximum number of repetition of the individual segments is limited to the ones which are actually used. This does, however, not constitute a limitation, but rather a more detailed description of the example used. INTRODUCTION SAP Business Network receives Remittance Advice with the cXML PaymentRemittanceRequest document. As a service to Suppliers preferring to transact via EDIFACT, SAP Business Network maps to the D.96A REMADV Remittance Advice message. Suppliers can select EDIFACT as their preferred method for receiving Remittance Advices. SAP Business Network uses EDIFACT Syntax version 3 and Syntax levels UNOC. Due to Syntax version 3 requirements, SAP Business Network always sends a UNA segment. SAP Business Network does not use functional groups. The envelope structure is UNA-UNB-UNH. CONTRL message acknowledgements are required by SAP Business Network. The complete contents of the PaymentRemittanceRequest are preserved as much as possible in this REMADV implementation. However, EDIFACT imposes limitations on element sizes as well as element and segment repetitions, where cXML does not. USING THIS GUIDELINE The DETAILED SEGMENT DESCRIPTION shows the Standard Edifact Rules, defined in D.96A, and the User Rules, recommended by SAP Business Network. Unused segments are not shown. The codes defining in detail Segment and Element usages are: Status Standard Edifact SAP Business Network Usage M Mandatory Must Use / Required by SAP Business Network C Conditional Conditional X Not Used Not Used Descriptions for segments have been provided alongside and detailed explanation will follow in a future release. -- 4 of 10 -- REMADV Remittance advice message Outbound Version UN/EDIFACT D.96A Implementation Guideline 1.5 Jun-17, 2024 © 2016-2024 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company.
