file://SBN/split/Supplier Guide to SAP B.content: Prerequisites • This feature requires that you are enabled for one of the following: • • • • The inventory collaboration component. The forecast collaboration component. SAP Business Network Planning Collaboration, which does not also require SAP Business Network for Supply Chain. To access this job type from the Upload/Download tabs, you must have one of the following permissions: • • Jobs and Upload/Download Downloads Forecast Visibility Planning Collaboration Visibility Suppliers may also access this job type from the permissions listed above. Upload/Download Uploads tab, if they have any of the Restrictions When the template Excel file is uploaded, it is converted to one or more cXML documents in the backend. Each cXML document is limited to 500 items. If the template Excel file has more than 500 items, multiple cXML documents are created. Manufacturing Visibility Template Criteria The Upload/Download type: • • • • • • • • Jobs page provides the following search criteria for the Manufacturing Visibility job Name – (Required) The name to give the job. Type – (Required) Choose Manufacturing Visibility. Customer – (Required, supplier view only) The name of the customer whose data you want in the report. Supplier – The name of the supplier whose data you want in the report. To retrieve information for all suppliers, leave this field blank. Supplier part number Buyer part number Location Time bucket – (Required) Values are Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, or Yearly. The following table shows the maximum date range for each time bucket. Time Bucket Maximum Date Range Daily 1825 days Weekly 260 weeks Monthly 60 months Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 191 • Time Bucket Maximum Date Range Quarterly 20 quarters Yearly 10 years Start – The starting date in the time window. You can define the starting date in the following ways: • • • • Current – The starting date is the current date for the time bucket. Previous – The starting date is a previous date in the time bucket. An additional field displays for you to enter a numeric value. Custom – The starting date is a custom date. An additional field displays for you to enter a custom date. End – The ending date in the time window. You can define the ending date in the following ways: • After – An additional field displays for you to enter a numeric value. The ending date is the date after the number of time buckets specified by this value. For example, if the Time bucket is Daily, and you enter 250 for the value, the ending date is after 250 days. If the time bucket is Weekly, and you enter 26 for the value, the ending date is after 26 weeks. • Custom – The ending date is a custom date. An additional field displays for you to enter a custom date. • • Download planning item attributes on all rows – Check to populate all cells in the Excel file with data. • • Supplier last modified – Date field. Only download planning records with positive or negative time series data – Check to only include planning records that have at least one positive or negative value in the specified time window. Customer view – Choose All Views or choose a specific view. Downloaded Excel files contain the key figures and attributes included in the view. Related Information Creating an Upload/Download Job [page 218] Running an Upload/Download Job and Making Data Changes to Upload [page 219] Deleting Download Files Created by an Upload/Download Job [page 221] Order Change Requests Template for Upload/Download Suppliers can retrieve change request information and also respond to those requests. You can use an Excel template, prepopulated with data from a purchase order, to accept, reject, or propose changes to multiple change requests from your buyers.  Note You can alternatively respond to order change requests from your buyers by using the Order Change Requests tile in the supplier Workbench. For more information, see Order change requests Tile for the Supplier Workbench [page 50]. 192 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download Prerequisites The following columns in the generated Order Change Request Excel file each require the buyer to enable a transaction rule, to allow proposing a change in that column. If you enter a proposed value in a column whose transaction rule is not enabled for you, the file upload fails with an error message. Column name Required rule Supplier proposed delivery date Allow suppliers to respond to a change request with a different delivery date than the buyer proposed. Supplier proposed quantity Allow suppliers to respond to a change request with a different quantity than the buyer proposed. Estimated cost Allow suppliers to request an additional cost when responding to a buyer request to change a schedule line.  Note This column is valid only if the supplier also proposes a different delivery date or quantity. The following permissions are added at role creation for users for suppliers: Table 1: Permissions and Descriptions Added at Role Creation Permission Description Order Change Request Acceptance Allows the user to accept the changes proposed for the purchase order in the order change request Order Change Request Rejection Allows the user to reject the changes proposed for the purchase order in the order change request Order Change Request Proposal Allows the user to propose alternate values for the changes proposed for purchase order in the order change request Restrictions • The Order Change Requests template for Upload/Download does not support change requests for scheduling agreements or scheduling agreement releases. • • You can make only one response or proposal per change request. Your response in the template's Action column must be capitalized: Accept, Reject or Propose. If a response begins with a lowercase letter (accept, reject, propose), the template upload fails with an error. Order Change Request Template Criteria The Upload/Download type: Jobs page provides the following search criteria for the Order Change Request job Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 193 • • • • • • • • • • Name – (Required) A name to give the job. Type – Choose Order Change Request. Customer – (Required) The name of the buyer whose data you want in the report. Order number – The ID of the purchase order. Company location Company code Order line-item number Schedule-line number Customer part number Creation date – The creation date or range of creation dates to include. Field choices are: • • • • • • • • Current Date Minus, with a Days field for the desired number of days before the current date Current Date (default) Current Date Plus, with a Days field for the desired number of days after the current date Other, with fields to choose the Start date and End date of the time period. Customer-proposed delivery date – Field choices are the same as for Creation date. Priority code Reason code Change by number of days – The number of days that a Customer proposed delivery date is earlier or later than the order's current Delivery date. Filter choices are None (the default), Days earlier, or Days later. For the Days earlier and Days later choices, the filter shows Min and Max fields. In these fields, you specify the minimum and maximum number of days difference that you want to include in the search results. The Min and Max fields have the following requirements: • At least one of these fields, Min or Max, must contain a value. Valid values are a number from 0 to 999. Both fields can be the same number. • The value of Min must not be greater than the value of Max. Actions Performed for Responses to Order Change Requests The following table describes the possible actions and results after a supplier responds to a change request: Submitted Response Actions Taken Accept 1. The buyer system accepts the confirmation. 2. The buyer system updates the change request with the supplier response. 3. The buyer system sends a change order with the accepted change to SAP Business Network. 4. The buyer system sends a change-request confirmation to the supplier, which describes what was done with the change request or change-request response on the buyer's backend system. 194 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download Submitted Response Actions Taken Reject 1. The buyer system accepts the rejection. 2. The buyer system updates the change request with the supplier response. 3. No change order is sent to SAP Business Network. 4. The buyer system sends a change-request confirmation to the supplier, which describes what was done with the change request or change-request response on the buyer's backend system. Propose, accepted by the buyer 1. The buyer accepts the proposal. 2. The buyer system updates the change request with the supplier response. 3. The buyer system sends a change order with the accepted change to SAP Business Network. 4. The buyer system sends a change-request confirmation to the supplier, which describes what was done with the change request or change-request response on the buyer's backend system. Propose, rejected by the buyer 1. The buyer rejects the proposal. 2. The buyer system updates the change request with the supplier response. 3. No change order is sent to SAP Business Network. 4. The buyer system sends a change-request confirmation to the supplier, which describes what was done with the change request or change-request response on the buyer's backend system. Related Information Creating an Upload/Download Job [page 218] Running an Upload/Download Job and Making Data Changes to Upload [page 219] Deleting Download Files Created by an Upload/Download Job [page 221] Responding to Purchase-Order Change Requests Using an Upload/ Download Template Suppliers can download an Excel template to respond to purchase-order change requests from their buyers. Context This template can upload up to 1,000 records.  Restriction • You cannot use the Order change request response template to respond to change requests for scheduling agreements or scheduling agreement releases. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 195 • The template is available in English only. Procedure 1. From the More actions (…) icon, choose Upload/Download Uploads , then click Upload. 2. In the Upload File popup, click the Download templates link. 3. Save and expand the templates.zip file. 4. From the downloaded templates folder, open the OrderChangeRequestResponseUploadTemplaterandom-number_data.xlsx spreadsheet file for editing. 5. For each change request you want to respond to, enter information in the editable columns of the spreadsheet, then save the file. The following spreadsheet columns are editable: • Action – Enter Accept, Reject, or Propose.  Note This field is case sensitive – you must capitalize the action name you enter. If you enter an action in lowercase, such as "reject" instead of "Reject", the spreadsheet upload will fail with an error. • • • • Rejection Reason – If you entered Reject in the Action column, enter a reason code. Supplier Proposed Delivery Date – Enter or select a date. Supplier Proposed Quantity – Enter a quantity. Supplier Proposed Quantity UOM – Enter the unit of measure for the value in the Supplier Proposed Quantity column. • Estimated Cost – Enter an amount. The field allows a period (.) in the amount, but no commas (,). This field is valid only when the buyer has proposed a different delivery date or quantity. • • Estimated Cost Currency – Enter the type of currency for the value in the Estimated Cost column. Comments – Enter any comments.  Tip You can download change request information from the Order change requests tile of the supplier Workbench to copy into the spreadsheet. After you set the tile filters to display in the list view the information you need, choose the export button  that shows above the list view table. All information visible in the list view is downloaded to an .xlsx file. 6. Return to the Upload File popup and complete the following fields: • • • Name – Enter a name to call the file you want to upload. This name is also used in the download log-file name. Type – Choose Order Change Request Response. File – Choose your edited template file. 7. Click Upload. The Upload File popup closes, and the Uploads tab shows your file being processed. Click Refresh Status to update the Status field. When processing is finished, this feature automatically sends the responses in .json 196 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download format to the buyers, for the buyers to accept or reject. The responses are also reflected in the Order change requests tile of the supplier Workbench. Related Information Responding to Change Requests Using the Supplier Workbench [page 54] Order Confirmation Template for Upload/Download You can use an Excel template, prepopulated with data from a purchase order, to submit mass order confirmations or to reconfirm purchase order items.  Note To instead use a CSV template, which isn't prepopulated with data, see Uploading Order Confirmations in CSV Format. For guidelines to follow when you mass confirm orders or releases at the schedule line level, see Schedule-Line Confirmations in Excel Format [page 200]. Restrictions • Orders that have at least one service line item are not supported to be confirmed from the Order Confirmation template for Upload/Download. See Service Order Confirmations for more information. • An Order Confirmation job excludes from the generated spreadsheet file any items that are fully shipped, fully received, or both. Order Confirmation Template Criteria The Upload/Download type: • • • • Jobs page provides the following search criteria for the Order Confirmation job Name – (Required) The name to give the job. Type – (Required) Choose Order Confirmation. Customer – (Required) The name of the buyer whose data you want in the report. Order type – Choose All (default) or Scheduling agreements.  Note For scheduling agreements and scheduling agreement releases, the generated download includes schedule-line items that are not confirmed only if the buyer allows suppliers to confirm them. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 197 • • Order number • • Date type – Choose Need By (default) or Ship By. Product group – Choose Line of Business (default), Product Family,Product SubFamily, Program Code, Part Category, or Part Type, and enter in the blank field the specific product-group information to search for. Date Range – Choose Current Date Minus (default), Current Date, Current Date Plus, Current Date +/-, or Other. • • • • • • • Search by – Choose Line item date range(default) or Schedule line date range. Supplier part number Buyer part number Location Planner code Include already-confirmed data – Check this box to reconfirm purchase order items. Do not include data from new orders Editing the Order Confirmation Spreadsheet After you run an Order Confirmation template job and download the Excel spreadsheet, you can add your data to it, then upload the file back into the system without error. If you don't want to confirm the whole item quantity required for a given line, reduce the value in the Confirmation Quantity column or remove the entire line.  Note For order confirmation files with temporary unit prices, you must enter detail in the Item Type column of each item with a temporary unit price. Otherwise, when you upload the file, any item with a temporary unit price that has accept in the Item Type column fails with an error message.  Caution The values in the Requested Quantity and Need By date columns are intended for information only. Do not change any values in these columns. Uploading an Excel file where the Requested Quantity and Need By date columns are missing will not cause the upload to fail. Buyer Customizations Your buyers can customize the Order Confirmation Excel template. They can customize both the standard and custom attributes in the template. • • 198 Buyers can enter alternate labels and translations for both standard and custom attributes. For standard attributes, buyers can customize which optional standard attributes to include in the template. Required standard attributes are always included. PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download • For custom attributes, buyers can make the following customizations: • Define custom attribute to be read only. You cannot change the value of a custom attribute a buyer defines as read only. • Define custom attribute to be required. When a custom attribute is required and you leave it empty and try to upload the Order Confirmation Excel file from the displays in the log. … Upload/Download Uploads tab, the upload fails, and an error message • Validate the length of a custom attribute. When you upload the template, SAP Business Network validates the length of the custom attribute to make sure it is within the specified length range defined by the buyer. • Set default value of a custom attribute to None. When the buyer sets the default value of a custom attribute to None, you fill in the value when you edit the template. Editable Time Zone The Excel spreadsheet generated by the Order Confirmation template includes a Time Zone field that is located in the header banner. When you download the Excel spreadsheet, the Time Zone field is automatically populated with your preferred time zone, which is set in My Account Preferences Preferred Time Zone . You can edit the Time Zone field in the Excel spreadsheet. The value of the Time Zone field must be in UTC format: -n or +n ; for example, -7 and +4.  Note Changing the time zone in header doesn't change the values of the date fields automatically. The supplier needs to change the date fields manually to match the fields with the time zone specified in the Excel template. The value of the Time Zone field is applied to the Order Date, Item Delivery Date, and Item Shipment Date fields of the spreadsheet.  Note The dates appearing in the SAP Business Network user interface might be different from the dates in the Excel spreadsheet. This difference can happen if the browser time-zone setting isn't in sync with the Preferred Time Zone value in your account. Related Information Creating an Upload/Download Job [page 218] Running an Upload/Download Job and Making Data Changes to Upload [page 219] Deleting Download Files Created by an Upload/Download Job [page 221] Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 199 Schedule-Line Confirmations in Excel Format Suppliers can use an Excel file to mass upload order confirmations at the schedule-line level. Description Suppliers can use an Upload/Download Excel file, the Order Confirmation template, to perform mass order confirmations. When you create a job on the Upload/Download page to download data, and the line item has one or more schedule lines, the information is downloaded at schedule line level by default. This download behavior occurs regardless of whether the rule Require suppliers to send order confirmations for material orders at the schedule line-item level is enabled. Prerequisites • For scheduling agreement and scheduling agreement releases order confirmation upload using Excel files, the following rules must be enabled: • • • Allow scheduling agreement collaboration Allow scheduling agreement release collaboration Allow suppliers to send order confirmations for scheduling agreements and scheduling agreement releases • When a supplier uploads an Excel order confirmation file, and the rule Require suppliers to send order confirmations for material orders at the schedule line-item level is enabled, the Schedule Line Number column is mandatory. • Buyers configure the quantity and delivery date tolerances by sending confirmation control keys in the purchase order. If no confirmation control keys are sent in the purchase order, the following rules are used: • • • Apply line item delivery date tolerance to order confirmations. Apply line item quantity tolerance to order confirmation. When the rule Validate tolerance for quantity, delivery date, or both at the schedule-line level is enabled, the tolerances set by the control keys or the preceding rules are evaluated at schedule-line level. Restrictions Suppliers can't confirm Forecast or Tradeoff schedule lines, and these lines aren't downloaded to an Excel file. If a supplier manually adds Forecast or Tradeoff schedule lines to the file and uploads it, the system shows an error message. Related Information Schedule-Line Confirmations in CSV Format 200 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download

file://SBN/split/Supplier Guide to SAP B.content: Subsequent Confirmations Using the Order Confirmation Template for Upload/Download Suppliers can confirm additional quantities of a partially confirmed item. If an item was partially confirmed, the remaining quantity for confirmation is downloaded in a single line, without schedule line number. The delivery date is the item’s delivery date. The following examples show quantities and schedule line numbers for line items and schedule lines (SL). Example 1: When a line item has more than one schedule line. PO1 Item 1 – qty. 100 – June 10 SL1 qty 50 – June 10 SL2 qty 50 – June 15 Supplier downloads order confirmation data: PO Number Item Number Schedule Line Number Item Quantity Item Delivery Date PO1 Line 1 1 50 June 10 PO1 Line 1 2 50 June 15 Supplier updates the data and uploads the following: PO Number Item Number Schedule Line Number Item Quantity Item Delivery Date PO1 Line 1 1 50 June 10 PO1 Line 1 2 20 June 15 PO1 Line 1 2 25 June 16 When supplier downloads data for confirmation to the Excel file one more time (without checking the checkbox Include already confirmed data), the following is downloaded: • Since the confirmed quantity is 95 (50+20+25) and the line item quantity is 100, the open quantity for confirmation is 5. • The item’s delivery date is June 10. PO Number Item Number PO1 Line 1 Schedule Line Number Item Quantity 5 Item Delivery Date June 10 The schedule line number is not displayed.  Note If a supplier needs to see the records that were previously confirmed, they must check the Include alreadyconfirmed data checkbox. Example 2: When a line item has only one schedule line. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 201 If a line item was partially confirmed, but it has only one schedule line, the remaining quantity for confirmation displays the schedule line number. The delivery date is the schedule line’s delivery date (which in this case is the same as the item’s delivery date). PO1 Item 1 qty 100 – June 10 SL1 – qty 100 – June 10 Supplier downloads order confirmation data: PO Number Item Number Schedule Line Number Item Quantity Item Delivery Date PO1 Line 1 1 June 10 100 Supplier updates the data and uploads the following: PO Number Item Number Schedule Line Number Item Quantity Item Delivery Date PO1 Line 1 1 60 June 10 PO1 Line 1 1 10 June 11 When a supplier downloads data for confirmation to an Excel file one more time (without checking the Include already-confirmed data checkbox), the following is downloaded: Since the confirmed quantity is 70 (60+10) and the line item quantity is 100, the open quantity for confirmation is 30. The schedule line number is displayed. The schedule line’s delivery date is June 10. PO Number Item Number Schedule Line Number Item Quantity Item Delivery Date PO1 Line 1 1 June 10 30 Supplier Reconfirmation Using the Order Confirmation Template for Upload/Download Suppliers can reconfirm certain confirmed items that do not have a schedule line number. When a supplier creates a job to download purchase order data for confirmation and chooses the checkbox Include already confirmed data, the schedule line number of the already confirmed records is displayed in the Excel file (if it is available). If the rule Require suppliers to send order confirmations for material orders at the schedule line-item level is enabled, and previously confirmed records do not have a schedule line number (because the rule was not enabled at that time) when a supplier downloads already confirmed data, the Schedule Line Number column is empty. However, the supplier must update it because this information is mandatory when the rule is enabled. 202 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download Quality Inspection Results Template for Upload/Download You can use the Quality Inspection Results template for Upload/Download to help manage quality inspections. Prerequisites You have a trading relationship with a buyer entitled for the quality collaboration component. Restrictions If your buyer has enabled electronic signatures for quality inspections, you cannot use the Quality Inspection Results template for Upload/Download since the Upload/Download workflow does not support electronically signing inspection results. Quality Inspection Results Template Criteria The Upload/Download job type: • • • • • • • • • • • • • Jobs page provides the following search criteria for the Quality Inspection Results Name – (Required) The name to give the job. Type – (Required) Choose Quality Inspection Results. Customer – (Required) The name of the customer whose data you want in the report. Customer location Customer inspection no. Customer part no. Customer batch Date type – Select Creation date or Due date. Inspection from – (Required) The start date from the selected Date type. Inspection to – (Required) The end date from the selected Date type. Supplier part no. Supplier batch Inspection status – The available statuses are All, Pending, Submitted, and Partially reviewed. Editing the Quality Inspection Results Excel File Downloaded Quality Inspection Results Excel files contain the following four sheets, which are prepopulated with information for the Customer you select. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 203  Note Editable columns in the Excel file display with a light-blue color.  Note For the Single Result and Summarized Recording sheets, some columns including Mean value, Above range, Below range, Within range, and Non-conformance are not updated immediately when you insert results for characteristics. Instead, these columns will display information the next time you download the Quality Inspection Results Excel file. 1. Inspections The Inspections sheet contains a row for each Customer inspection no. If the Supplier inspection no. column in the row is empty, fill it in with a value. You can also fill in the optional Supplier batch column. No other columns can be edited. 2. Single Result The Single Result sheet contains rows for inserting individual results for characteristics. For example, suppose a characteristic has 10 samples, and the allowed values are numeric, where the expected result is between 85 and 95. The characteristic is considered as 100% passed only when all 10 samples have a value in this range. 3. Summarized Recording The Summarized Recording sheet contains rows for inserting only one result for characteristics. For example, suppose a characteristic can accept a value of Accept or Decline. If you enter Accept for this characteristic, Accept is the inspection result. 4. Attachments The Attachments sheet contains rows for each certificate or file attached to the quality inspection results. Each row includes the attachment name and the attachment type. Each inspection can have multiple attachments. You cannot edit this sheet; its content is for your information only. Attaching Files When Uploading the Quality Inspection Results Excel File As part of the quality inspection process, you are often required to upload corresponding certificates or other documents with the inspection results. When you upload inspection results using the Quality Inspection Results Excel file, you can add these certificates and documents by clicking Attach Files. If your buyer configured the file extensions allowed for attachments, any attachment you upload must have one of these extensions.  Note You can delete attachments that were uploaded with a prior version of the Quality Inspection Results Excel file. You can then add new attachments when you upload your latest inspection results. 204 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download The attachments are validated, and if all validations pass, the Quality Inspection Results Excel file is uploaded.  Note • By default, the cumulative size of attachments associated with a document cannot exceed 10 MB. Customers can request to change that limit, which can be changed from 10 MB to 100 MB. • During file upload, attachment files are converted to plain ASCII text using base64 encoding. This conversion increases the file size by approximately 35%. Therefore, the actual file size limit is 65% of the configured maximum limit. For example, if the maximum allowed limit is set to 10 MB (10000 KB), the actual total attachment file size that users can add is 6500 KB. • SAP Business Network stores attachments for a maximum period of eighteen months, after which the attachments expire and are no longer available online. Ship Notice Template for Upload/Download A supplier can use a prepopulated Excel template to create multiple ship notices in one operation. The Ship Notice job type retrieves orders that contain a remaining due quantity that can be shipped and that meet the job's search criteria. Orders can be a purchase order, scheduling agreement, or scheduling agreement release. A generated Ship Notice job can contain up to 10,000 lines, in addition to the header lines. Any excess lines are excluded from the job download file. When the results of a ship notice job exceed the line limit, the downloaded job template includes a notification message that some results were excluded from the template.  Note You can alternatively upload ship notices with a CSV template that is not prepopulated with data. Supplier part number Buyer part number Location Data Entry and Upload Observe the following guidelines for editing a Ship Notice Excel template you download from the Download • Downloads … Upload/ page, and for uploading the edited file: A time zone is required in the Ship Notice template. When you download a Ship Notice template, the time zone shown in the file header is the same as your preferred time zone that is set in the My Account Preferences Preferred Time Zone Account Settings field. You can edit the header time zone in the template. • The edited Ship Notice template that you upload cannot have more than 10,000 lines, in addition to the header lines. • The Ship Notice template allows uploading Item Customer Part ID data without requiring an Item Supplier Part ID. • Only the Item Serial Number field of the Ship Notice Excel template accepts multiple values in the same field. To enter multiple serial numbers in this field, separate the serial numbers with pipe (|) characters.  Example serial_no.1 | serial_no.-2 | serial_no.3  Note The pipe (|) character is not recognized as a delimiter by any other field of the Ship Notice template. SAP Business Network treats content in any other Ship Notice template field as a single entry, even if an entry includes standard delimiters. • Ensure that all units of measure (UOMs) in the ship notice are valid. When a ship notice is submitted, SAP Business Network validates the UOMs against the master list of UOMs that the buyer uploaded. If no master list is uploaded, SAP Business Network validates UOMs against the standard UN/CEFACT list. If the ship notice contains an invalid UOM, it fails submission. • You can attach files to ship-notice entries in a Ship Notice template file during the upload process. For details, see Adding Attachments to Ship Notices [page 212]. • If the Ship Notice Date field is empty when you upload the template, this feature automatically places the current system date and time into the field. For details, see Date Field Autocompletion [page 212]. • Your buyers can customize the Ship Notice Excel template. They can customize both the standard and custom attributes in the template. • • Buyers can enter alternate labels and translations for both standard and custom attributes. For standard attributes, buyers can customize which optional standard attributes to include in the template. Required standard attributes are always included. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 211 • For custom attributes, buyers can make the following customizations: • Define custom attribute to be read only. You cannot change the value of a custom attribute a buyer defines as read only. • Define custom attribute to be required. When a custom attribute is required and you leave it empty and try to upload the Ship Notice Excel file from the the log. … Upload/Download Uploads tab, the upload fails, and an error message displays in • Validate the length of a custom attribute. When you upload the template, SAP Business Network validates the length of the custom attribute to make sure it is within the specified length range defined by the buyer. • Set default value of a custom attribute to None. When the buyer sets the default value of a custom attribute to None, you fill in the value when you edit the template. Adding Attachments to Ship Notices Observe the following guidelines for adding attachments: • • You can attach more than one attachment file to a ship notice. The total file size of all attachments to the same ship notice can be no more than the file-size limit that is set for attachments. • Each attachment file name must be unique for that ship notice. The following steps describe how to add an attachment to a Ship Notice template file: 1. Go to … Upload/Download Uploads and choose Upload File. 2. In the popup, choose the Ship Notice template file you want to upload. A table appears that lists all ship notices in the file. 3. In the table of ship notice, click the Attach files link for the ship notice you want to add an attachment to. 4. Browse to the file to attach and choose it. The attachment file name appears in the ship notice entry and has a delete icon ( ) at the end of its line. Date Field Autocompletion In a Ship Notice template that is uploaded from the … Upload/Download Uploads page, the autocompletion feature appends the time 12:00:00 to date fields that use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Date autocompletion is executed only where a date's format is YYYY-MM-DD.  Note If a date field is empty, the autocompletion feature is not executed for that field. Date autocompletion in the Ship Notice template has the following requirements and behavior: • 212 By default, all date fields appear in the YYYY-MM-DD T hh:mm:ss.TZD format. PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download • • • • • • • • YYYY specifies the year. MM specifies the month. DD specifies the day. hh specifies the hour. mm specifies the minute. ss specifies the second. T marks the beginning of the time value. Do not include a space before or after the T component. TZD specifies the time zone designator. It can be either + hh:mm or - hh:mm.  Note • • If a date is specified in a format other than either YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD T hh:mm:ss.TZD, upload of the ship-notice template is rejected with an error message. • If the time zone TZD defined in the header is not in the standard list of time zones by UTC offset, upload of the ship notice template is rejected with an error message. The autocompletion feature applies to the following fields: • • • • • Agreement Date Delivery Date Ship Notice Date Shipment Date Tracking Date Related Information Creating an Upload/Download Job [page 218] Running an Upload/Download Job and Making Data Changes to Upload [page 219] Deleting Download Files Created by an Upload/Download Job [page 221] Block and closed line-item status during Ship Notice creation This feature adds blocking of line items and improves closing of line items in purchase orders in SAP Business Network. For both blocked and closed line items, suppliers are prevented from creating any subsequent documents (order confirmation and ship notice). This feature adds the following to the ItemOut element in an OrderRequest document: • operation="block" attribute – When this attribute is included in an ItemOut element, the line item is blocked in the purchase order. • Indicator element – This element is used to define indicators. It has the following two attributes: Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 213 1. Type – The indicator name. 2. Level – The indicator level. Can be set to warning or error. For example, buyers configure hard (error) or soft (warning) validation in their ERP using the isDeliveryCompleted indicator. In the following code sample, the isDeliveryCompleted indicator is set to hard validation: <ItemOut> <ItemID> <SupplierPartID/> <BuyerPartID>HWWB348A40</BuyerPartID> </ItemID> <ItemDetail></ItemDetail> <Tax></Tax> <Contact role="BuyerPlannerCode"></Contact> <TermsOfDelivery></TermsOfDelivery> <Comments type="Material Purchase Order text" xml:lang="EN">O-RING 348 AS 568 FEPM-90</Comments> <Indicator type="isDeliveryCompleted" level="error"></Indicator> </ItemOut> For more information, see Support Close Purchase Order lines [page 216] and Support Block Purchase Order line Items [page 217]. Changes to the User Interface This feature adds functionality for blocked line items and improves functionality for closed line items in purchase orders in SAP Business Network. Blocked Line Items For blocked line items, this feature improves visibility for hosted and integrated suppliers to which line items are blocked. Prior to this feature, blocked lines items were treated as deleted line items, and they were not included in the purchase order cXML file sent to suppliers. This confused suppliers because they did not know what happened to the missing line items. They only knew that they could not create any subsequent documents against those line items. With this feature, blocked line items display on the Purchase Order Order Details page with Blocked in the Change column. Prior to this feature, the line item was treated as cancelled, a new line item was created, and the Change column displayed Edited. When buyers configure the Send notification to suppliers when purchase orders are changed rule in the Electronic Order Routing section, SAP Business Network sends email notifications to the configured suppliers when line items are blocked. When all line items in a purchase order are blocked, SAP Business Network receives a change order and sends an email notification to the supplier. When the buyer unblocks a line item, the previous document history is retained. Prior to this feature, when the line item was unblocked, the history of the line item was lost. When the buyer unblocks a line item, the line item will not have the operation="block" attribute in the next change order. Order Confirmations behavior for Blocked Line Items • For Order Confirmation created directly from the Purchase Order (PO) page, blocked Purchase Order lines are not flipped into the Order Confirmation. • • For Items to Confirm workbench tile, blocked Purchase Order lines are not available for confirmation. 214 For Order Confirmation created through CSV/Excel upload, blocked Purchase Order lines do not appear in the template. PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download • For integrated Order Confirmations, if B2B suppliers include blocked items in the Order Confirmation document then SAP Business Network rejects the transaction. Ship Notices behavior for Blocked Line Items • For Ship Notices created directly from the Purchase Order (PO) page, blocked Purchase Order lines are not flipped into the Ship Notice. • • For Items to Ship workbench tile, blocked Purchase Order lines are not available for shipment. • For Ship Notices created through CSV/Excel upload, blocked Purchase Order lines do not appear in the template. For integrated Ship Notices, if B2B suppliers include blocked items in the Ship Notice document then SAP Business Network rejects the transaction. Closed Line Items In order to close line items, a purchase order must be at least partially received. Some reasons buyers may want to close line items are: • • • It is the end of the month or quarter, and there is an accounts payable freeze. They want to close all line items that have not been invoiced. They want to close line items for services after the services are delivered. Buyers configure hard (error) or soft (warning) validation in their ERP using the isDeliveryCompleted indicator. See the cXML Changes section above for sample code. When the buyer configures hard validation, the supplier cannot continue creating documents against the closed line item. When the buyer configures soft validation, the supplier can continue creating documents against the closed line item. When the buyer sends a change order to close a line item, and the isDeliveryCompleted indicator is set to error (hard validation in the ERP), the open purchase order quantity becomes zero, even if the full quantity has not been delivered. SAP Business Network will fail any documents against line items that are already closed. Prior to this feature, SAP Business Network did not prevent suppliers from submitting documents against closed line items. Order Confirmations behavior for Closed Line Items • • Purchase Order lines closed with hard validation are not flipped into the Order Confirmation. • • For Items to Confirm workbench tile, the closed Purchase Order lines are not available for confirmation. • If only few line items are marked in this way in the Purchase Order, the remaining lines can be flipped and be part of the OC creation. For Order Confirmation created through CSV/Excel Upload, Purchase Order lines closed with hard validation do not appear in the template after executing the corresPurchase Ordernding job. For integrated Order Confirmations, suppliers include items closed with hard validation in the Order Confirmation document, then SAP Business Network rejects the transaction including the proper reason. Ship Notices behavior for Closed Line Items • • • • Purchase Order lines closed with hard validation are not flipped into the Ship Notice. If only few line items are marked in this way in the Purchase Order, the remaining lines can be flipped and be part of the ASN creation. For Items to Ship workbench tile, the closed Purchase Order lines are not available for shipment. For Ship Notices created through CSV/Excel Upload, Purchase Order lines closed with hard validation do not appear in the template after executing the corresPurchase Ordernding job. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 215 • For integrated Ship Notices, suppliers include items closed with hard validation in the Ship Notice document, then SAP Business Network rejects the transaction including the proper reason. Support Close Purchase Order lines Business Details Business Details This feature enables buyers to close line items in purchase orders by configuring the DeliveryCompleted indicator. cXML Changes A new attribute DeliveryCompleted indicates that the message type is Error or Warning. The attribute is mapped out to the indicator element in the Order Request cXML and SAP Business Network marks the Line Items as Closed. When buyers set the DeliveryCompleted indicator to error, the open purchase quantity item becomes zero even if the entire shipment is not completed. SAP Business Network fails any document created against the closed line item when the DeliveryCompleted indicator to error. When buyers set the DeliveryCompleted indicator to warning, suppliers can continue creating documents against the closed line item. CoC Select the company code. Msg.Type PO Vndr attr CLMTYP Vendor specific attribute values Maintain one of the following values: • • E: For error or hard validation. W: For warning or soft validation. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download PUBLIC 219  Note To upload changes using a Manufacturing Planning Visibility template, instead see Updating an Upload/ Download Template for Manufacturing Planning Visibility [page 184]. Procedure 1. Select the created job from the … Upload/Download The view switches to the Downloads tab. Jobs list and click Run. 2. Click Refresh Status to update the processing status. Choose the name of your template from the Type dropdown. b. Enter the name to give your upload in the Name field. c. Click Browse to choose the file to upload. d. Click Upload. Click Refresh Status to update the processing status. Processing is finished when Completed shows in the Status column.  Note If Completed With Errors shows in the Status column for your upload, click the download icon  in the Log column to open the log file. The log provides operation status for each confirmed purchase order, 220 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Upload/Download

For additional reports that are available to all SAP Business Network suppliers, see the Reports and Report Templates guide. Report Types for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Suppliers [page 222] Creating a Report Template [page 237] Generating and Downloading Reports [page 239] Viewing a Generated Report with Double-Byte or Accented Characters [page 240] Report Types for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Suppliers Each report type has criteria to customize when you create a report template. This section describes the report types that are available to suppliers who are enabled for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain.  Note For information about report types available to all SAP Business Network suppliers, see the Reports and Report Templates guide. Component Shipment Report [page 223] Multi-Tier Order Report [page 224] Order Report with Serial-Number and Schedule-Line Information [page 225] Open Orders Report [page 227] Quality Inspection Report [page 233] Quality Notification Report [page 234] Serial Number Report [page 235] 222 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Reports Component Shipment Report Suppliers enabled for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain can create a Component Shipment report in Excel format to show selected information from multiple component ship notices. Component Shipment Report Criteria Field Description Customer Choose a customer name, or use the default value (All Customers) Component Ship Notice No. To report on a component ship notice with a specific number, enter the number in the text box. This field is case sensitive. Tracking Number Enter the tracking number associated with the component ship notice. Order Number To report on an order with a specific number, enter the number in the text box. This field is case sensitive. Shipping Organization Code Enter the code for the organization that ships the components. Receipt Status Choose one or more statuses (Open, Partially Received, or Fully Received), or use the default value (All). Prerequisites Determine what report criteria you wish to set in the report template. See Report Types for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Suppliers [page 222] for topics about each report type that is available to suppliers enabled for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Reports PUBLIC 237 Context When you create a report template, you set the type of report you want and criteria for which data to include in the generated report. You also set whether the report is generated manually or is run automatically at a schedule that you choose. Procedure 1. Choose Reports. The Reports page opens. 2. Click Create. The Report creation wizard opens. 3. Enter a unique title that will help you and other users easily identify this report from a list. For example, “Monthly Quality Notification Report.” 4. Enter a description. The description is useful for identifying the scope and target of the report for all account users. For example, “Monthly report of all New and In-Process quality notifications.” 5. Choose a value from the Time zone list. Dates and times in your generated report use the time zone you select here, expressed as GMT +/-. In addition, SAP Business Network uses the time zone to determine the range of information collected for the report. 6. Choose a language. SAP Business Network uses this language for labels in the generated report file. The report displays data in the language in which the information was entered into the system. 7. Choose a report type. See Report Types for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Suppliers [page 222] for details about each report type. 8. Click Next. SAP Business Network displays the Schedule page with details for the report type you selected. 9. Click either Manual Report or Scheduled Report. You generate manual reports from the Reports page. Scheduled reports are automatically generated by SAP Business Network, using the frequency that you specified. 10. If you choose Scheduled Report, the Scheduling fields display. Do the following: a. Select a date range. By default, a scheduled report includes three months beginning with tomorrow’s date. b. Choose a value from the Automatically Run list to set the report generation frequency. c. Enter up to three email addresses, each separated by single comma. SAP Business Network sends a notification to these addresses when the report status is Processed. 11. Click Next. 12. On the Criteria page, choose the parameters for the report. For information about the criteria available for your report type, see Report Types for SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Suppliers [page 222]. 238 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Reports 13. Click Submit. SAP Business Network puts your report into the queue. You can view and download it when its status becomes Processed. 14. To view and download the report, select the report template, click Download, then click one of the following: • • Open to view the report. Your browser starts Microsoft Excel and displays the report. Save to save the report to your hard disk. Next Steps To manually update the data in your report, see Generating and Downloading Reports [page 239]. Generating and Downloading Reports You can generate a report from a report template or edit and save an existing report. Prerequisites A report template to retrieve the desired data was created. For more information, see Creating a Report Template [page 237]. Context Your organization can generate a maximum of 100 reports, including up to 20 scheduled reports. SAP Business Network deletes generated reports from your account after 30 days. Procedure 1. Click Reports. The Reports page opens and shows the list of created report templates. 2. Determine your next step. • • To download the existing version of a report, skip to Step 3. To generate an updated report, choose the desired report template and click Run. SAP Business Network adds your report to the queue and returns you to the Reports page. To update the statuses of reports on the Reports page, click Refresh Status. You can view and download the report when its status changes to Processed. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Reports PUBLIC 239 3. To view and download an existing report, select the desired report template, click Download, then click one of the following: • • Open to view the report. Your browser starts Microsoft Excel and displays the report. Save to save the report to your hard disk. You can change the encoding and delimiter settings for these files. Context To keep a record of a scheduled report, save the report to your hard disk each time the report runs. If a report file is over 1 MB, SAP Business Network stores it in zip format and displays a zip icon in the Size column for that report. SAP Business Network deletes generated reports from your account after 30 days. Procedure 1. Choose Reports from the menu bar. 2. Select the report and click Download. Your browser prompts you to indicate whether you want to view the report or save it to disk. 3. Click Save. 4. Modify the file location and name, if necessary, and click Save. 5. Click Close. 6. Start a text viewer. 7. Click to open a file. 8. Choose All Files in the Files of type list. 9. Select the file you want to open. 10. Choose Unicode in the Encoding list. 11. Choose All Files in the Save as type list. 240 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Reports

Click the Account Settings icon in the upper right corner. 2. In the dropdown click Settings Electronic Order Routing . 3. In the Other Document Types section, set Return Ship Notices to one of the following: • Online – (Default) A buying organization sends all incoming return ship notices over the Internet to SAP Business Network, where they're visible in the user interface. • cXML – A buying organization sends all incoming return ship notices over the Internet to SAP Business Network, where they're visible in the user interface. SAP Business Network posts the documents over the Internet to your supplier cXML application on the web. • cXML Pending Queue – A buying organization sends all incoming return ship notices over the Internet to SAP Business Network, where they're visible in the user interface. Your cXML application must poll SAP Business Network for pending documents and download them. For more information, see Configuring Document Routing. Fields for Order Confirmation Control Keys This table describes the possible values for the Order Confirmation Control Key field: Order Confirmation Control Key Value Description Order confirmation allowed The supplier can create an order confirmation if they want to, but they are not required to. Creation of a ship notice or invoice does not depend upon the creation of an order confirmation. Order confirmation required The supplier must create an order confirmation. Failure to create an order confirmation will prevent the later creation of a ship notice. The system only checks for the existence of an order confirmation; quantities on the order confirmation do not have to match those on a ship notice. Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Field Reference for Suppliers PUBLIC 251 Order Confirmation Control Key Value Description Order confirmation not allowed The supplier cannot create an order confirmation for the purchase order line item, and the line item is not displayed on the Items to Confirm list when the “Only items that can be confirmed” filter option is selected. Field left blank There is no control specified for order confirmations at the purchase order line item level. Fields for Serial Number Upload The Manage Serial Number link on the Create Ship Notice page provides an Excel template to upload serial number information for ship notices and consumed components. Fields in the Ship Notice Worksheet The Ship Notice sheet of the serial number upload template has the following columns: Ship Notice Number An identifier for a particular shipment assigned by the supplier. A uservisible and secondary (to the payloadID attribute of the cXML element) identifier for this document. Purchase Order ID OrderID for a request that is an internal buyer unique number. Item Line Number Line number of an item in the referenced document. Item Supplier Part ID Identifier specified by the supplier for a product in the supplier system. Item Customer Part ID Identifier specified by the buyer for a product in the buyer system. Item Ship Notice Line Number The line number of current line item, copied from ShipNoticeRequest. Item Quantity Number of this line item which was ordered. Expressed in the unitsgiven in the UnitOfMeasure element. Item Batch ID Batch ID provided by the supplier at the line item quantity level to identify the batch in which the item or the product was produced. Item Production Date Date on which a batch of material or goods is produced. Item Expiration Date Date on which a batch of material or goods expires. Batch Quantity Quantity for a batch of material or goods. Item Serial Number Manufacturer's serial number for the unit. Item Asset Tag Asset tag number for the unit. Fields in the Consumed Components Worksheet The Consumed Components sheet of the serial number upload template has the following columns: 252 PUBLIC Supplier Guide to SAP Business Network for Supply Chain SAP Business Network for Supply Chain Field Reference for Suppliers Order ID The buyer system Order ID that is an internal unique number. Line Number Number of an item in the referenced document. Ship Notice Line Number The line number of current line item, copied from ShipNoticeRequest. Component Line Number The position of a component in the current consumption details. Customer Part ID It represents a component in buyer system specified by the buyer. Customer Batch ID The batch ID provided by the buyer for the component that is consumed. Part No. It represents a component in supplier system specified by the supplier. Batch No. The batch ID provided by the supplier at the line-item level to identify the batch assigned for the item. Quantity The quantity of component that is consumed. Unit Unit of measure code. Serial Number The representation of the required serial number information of a component. Related Information Uploading Serial Numbers for Ship Notices [page 81] Fields for Ship Notice Control Keys This table describes the possible values for the Ship Notice Control Key field: Ship Notice Control Key Value Description Ship notice allowed The supplier can create a ship notice if they want to, but they are not required to. Creation of an invoice does not depend upon the creation of a ship notice. Ship notice not allowed The supplier cannot create a ship notice for the purchase order line item, and the line item is not displayed on the Items to Ship list when the “Only items that can be shipped” filter option is selected. Field left blank There is no control specified for ship notices at the purchase order line item level. Fields for Third-Party Logistics Providers SAP Business Network sends new logistics-relationship request letters to suppliers when a buyer requests a logistics relationship. Suppliers can select routing options for Transport Request and Transport Confirmation by clicking the Account Settings icon in the upper right corner, then in the dropdown, click Settings Electronic Order Routing .
